name: 21s — EZ-Bar
setupNotes: Standing, EZ-bar. Perform 7 reps bottom-half range, 7 reps top-half range, 7 reps full range — 21 total. No rest between segments.

name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
setupNotes: Sit on floor with front leg bent 90 degrees in front and back leg bent 90 degrees to the side. Lean forward over the front shin to deepen the stretch through the front hip. Hip opener — switch sides to work both hips.

name: Ab Machine Crunch
setupNotes: Seated ab crunch machine. Adjust pad at chest or behind head. Select weight. Crunch forward against resistance, controlled return.

name: Active Dead Hang
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, full hang. Engage lats and depress shoulder blades without bending elbows. Scapular activation drill.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Biceps Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Alternating curl. Full supination at top, controlled lower. Elbows stationary.

name: Alternating Hammer Curl — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on a bench, dumbbell in each hand at sides with neutral (palms-in) grip. Curl one arm at a time, thumbs pointing up, lowering under control before the other side curls. Targets the brachialis and brachioradialis.

name: Alternating Hammer Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbell in each hand at sides with neutral (palms-in) grip. Curl one arm at a time, thumbs pointing up, lowering under control before the other side curls. Targets the brachialis and brachioradialis.

name: Alternating Superman
setupNotes: Lie face down, arms overhead. Lift opposite arm and leg simultaneously (right arm + left leg). Alternate sides. Controlled tempo.

name: Ankle Circles
setupNotes: Standing on one leg (hold support), rotate foot in circles. Clockwise then counterclockwise. 10 each direction. Switch feet.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Stretch
setupNotes: Half-kneeling facing a wall — the other knee down, one foot forward 4–6 inches from the wall. Drive the one knee forward toward the wall without lifting the one side heel off the floor. Mobilises the one side ankle into dorsiflexion.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Half-kneeling facing a wall — right knee down, left foot forward 4–6 inches from the wall. Drive the left knee forward toward the wall without lifting the left heel off the floor. Mobilises the left ankle into dorsiflexion.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Half-kneeling facing a wall — left knee down, right foot forward 4–6 inches from the wall. Drive the right knee forward toward the wall without lifting the right heel off the floor. Mobilises the right ankle into dorsiflexion.

name: Archer Pull-Up
setupNotes: Wide grip on pull-up bar. Pull toward one hand while extending the other arm straight. Alternate sides. Advanced unilateral progression.

name: Archer Push-Up
setupNotes: Very wide hand placement, body in straight line. Lower body toward the one hand while the the other arm extends straight out. Press back up through the one side — unilateral chest and tricep emphasis.

name: Archer Push-Up — Left
setupNotes: Very wide hand placement, body in straight line. Lower body toward the left hand while the right arm extends straight out. Press back up through the left side — unilateral chest and tricep emphasis.

name: Archer Push-Up — Right
setupNotes: Very wide hand placement, body in straight line. Lower body toward the right hand while the left arm extends straight out. Press back up through the right side — unilateral chest and tricep emphasis.

name: Arm Circles — Backward
setupNotes: Standing, arms extended straight out to sides at shoulder height. Circle arms backward, gradually increasing the size of the circles. Dynamic shoulder warm-up.

name: Arm Circles — Forward
setupNotes: Standing, arms extended straight out to sides at shoulder height. Circle arms forward, gradually increasing the size of the circles. Dynamic shoulder warm-up.

name: Weighted Arm Circles — Large Forward
setupNotes: Standing, light dumbbells (1-3 kg) in each hand, arms extended out to sides at shoulder height. Circle arms forward in large, controlled arcs. Dynamic shoulder warm-up with added load.

name: Arm Swings — Backward
setupNotes: Standing, swing both arms backward in large reverse arcs — pulling shoulders back and opening chest. Build momentum with each rep. Dynamic shoulder warm-up.

name: Arm Swings — Forward
setupNotes: Standing, swing both arms forward and up overhead in large arcs — then back down. Build momentum with each rep. Dynamic shoulder warm-up.

name: Arm Swings — Forward/Backward Continuous
setupNotes: Standing, swing both arms forward and up overhead in large arcs — then back down. Build momentum with each rep. Dynamic shoulder warm-up.

name: Arm Swings — Lateral
setupNotes: Standing tall, arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Swing both arms horizontally — open wide, then cross them in front of the chest and back open again, staying in the horizontal plane throughout. Dynamic warm-up for the chest, shoulders and upper back.

name: Arnold Press
setupNotes: Seated on upright bench with back support. Start with dumbbells at chin, palms facing you. Rotate palms outward as you press overhead.

name: Arnold Press — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbells at chin with palms facing you, elbows tight. Rotate palms outward as you press overhead — finish with arms locked, palms forward. Brace the core to prevent lower-back arching. Targets all three deltoid heads with extra core demand vs. seated.

name: Assault / Air Bike — Intervals
setupNotes: Air bike / assault bike. Arms and legs drive together. Sprint intervals (20-30 sec on, 60-90 sec off). Total body cardio.

name: Assisted Parallel Dip
setupNotes: Assisted dip/pull-up machine. Kneel or stand on pad, select counterweight. Upright torso for triceps focus. Full range of motion.

name: B-Stance Romanian Deadlift
setupNotes: Standing with one foot half a step behind (heel up). Most weight on front leg. Hinge at hips with dumbbells. Unilateral emphasis with bilateral stability.

name: Back Extension — Banded
setupNotes: Hyper-extension / back-extension bench. Pad at hip crease, feet anchored. Loop a resistance band around the upper back and under the foot platform — band adds tension at the top of the rep. Hinge at the hips down and up, hands behind head or crossed on chest.

name: Back Extension — Standard (Machine)
setupNotes: Hyper extension / back extension bench. Pad at hip crease, feet anchored. Hinge at hips down and up. Hands behind head or crossed on chest.

name: Back Extension — Standard (Machine) — Banded
setupNotes: Standard back-extension machine, pad against the upper back, feet anchored on the foot plate. Loop a resistance band around the chest pad and the base of the machine for added top-end tension. Extend the torso back against the pad — hinge through the hips, not the lower back. Trains spinal erectors and glutes.

name: Back Extension — Weighted
setupNotes: Same setup as standard. Hold weight plate or dumbbell against chest for added resistance. Controlled tempo.

name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
setupNotes: Loop resistance band over pull-up bar, step one or both feet into band. Perform pull-up with band support reducing bodyweight load.

name: Band Pull-Apart
setupNotes: Hold resistance band at chest height with straight arms, shoulder-width grip. Pull band apart by squeezing shoulder blades together. Controlled return.

name: Band Pull-Apart — 3 Position
setupNotes: Perform band pull-aparts at three heights: overhead, eye level, and chest level. Hits rear delts and rhomboids from different angles.

name: Band T-Raise
setupNotes: Stand on or anchor band low. Arms straight, raise to sides forming a T (arms horizontal). Lower controlled. Middle trap and rear delt.

name: Band W-Raise
setupNotes: Stand on or anchor band low. Pull into W-shape — elbows bent, upper arms at 45 degrees, hands at ear level. Squeeze shoulder blades. Rotator cuff.

name: Band Y-Raise
setupNotes: Stand on or anchor band low. Arms straight, raise into Y-shape overhead (arms at ~45 degrees from body). Lower controlled. Lower trap activation.

name: Banded Hip Thrust
setupNotes: Upper back on bench, resistance band across hips anchored by feet or heavy dumbbells. Drive hips up to full extension. Band adds tension at top.

name: Banded Hip Thrust — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, resistance band looped around the hips and anchored at low height behind you (rack post or band peg). Push the hips forward against band tension into a tall lockout, then return to a slight hinge. Squeeze glutes hard at the top — keep ribs down. A standing alternative to the floor hip thrust.

name: Banded Shoulder Distraction
setupNotes: Anchor a heavy band to a rack at shoulder height. Loop the band around the one side wrist and step away to create tension, then drop into a lunge or hinge so the band gently distracts the one side shoulder. Hold and breathe. Mobilises the one side shoulder capsule.

name: Banded Shoulder Distraction — Left
setupNotes: Anchor a heavy band to a rack at shoulder height. Loop the band around the left wrist and step away to create tension, then drop into a lunge or hinge so the band gently distracts the left shoulder. Hold and breathe. Mobilises the left shoulder capsule.

name: Banded Shoulder Distraction — Right
setupNotes: Anchor a heavy band to a rack at shoulder height. Loop the band around the right wrist and step away to create tension, then drop into a lunge or hinge so the band gently distracts the right shoulder. Hold and breathe. Mobilises the right shoulder capsule.

name: Barbell Back Squat — Paused
setupNotes: Power rack, bar on upper traps (high bar) or rear delts (low bar). Feet shoulder-width apart. Descend under control until thighs are at or below parallel and hold a deliberate 2–3 second pause at the bottom — no bouncing out of the hole. Drive up through the heels. Builds bottom-position strength and control.

name: Barbell Back Squat — Standard
setupNotes: Power rack, bar on upper traps (high bar) or rear delts (low bar). Feet shoulder-width apart. Descend until thighs parallel or below — drive up through heels.

name: Barbell Back Squat — Wide Stance
setupNotes: Power rack, bar on upper traps (high bar) or rear delts (low bar). Wide stance, toes angled out. Descend until thighs parallel or below — drive up through heels.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row — Overhand
setupNotes: Standing, hinge at hips ~45 degrees. Barbell hanging at arm's length, overhand grip. Row bar to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row — Underhand
setupNotes: Same hinge position as overhand row. Underhand (supinated) grip at shoulder-width. Row to lower stomach, elbows close to body.

name: Barbell Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, barbell with shoulder-width grip. Elbows pinned to sides. Curl to shoulder height, controlled lower. Avoid swinging torso.

name: Barbell Floor Press
setupNotes: Lie on floor with barbell. Knees bent, feet flat. Upper arms touch floor at bottom of each rep.

name: Barbell Floor Press — Close-Narrow Grip
setupNotes: Lie on floor with barbell. Knees bent, feet flat. Hands narrower than shoulders for triceps emphasis. Lower bar to chest, upper arms touch floor at bottom — press up explosively.

name: Barbell Front Squat
setupNotes: Power rack, bar across front delts in front rack (clean grip) or cross-arm position. Elbows high. Descend to parallel or below, upright torso.

name: Barbell Good Morning
setupNotes: Barbell on upper back (like a squat). Feet hip-width apart. Hinge at hips, push hips back, lower torso to roughly parallel — stand up by driving hips forward.

name: Barbell Good Morning — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on a flat bench, barbell across upper back as for a squat. Feet planted. Hinge forward at hips, chest down toward thighs. Drive hips and torso back up — isolates the lower back without leg involvement.

name: Barbell Hang Snatch
setupNotes: Barbell at hip level, wide snatch grip. Dip-drive hips, pull bar overhead, catch with straight arms. Start from hang position, not floor.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
setupNotes: Upper back on bench, barbell across hip crease (pad the bar). Feet flat on floor, hip-width. Drive hips up to full extension, squeeze glutes. Lower controlled.

name: Barbell Shrug
setupNotes: Standing, barbell held at hip level with overhand grip, shoulder-width. Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears. Brief hold at top, controlled lower.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher
setupNotes: Flat bench, barbell or EZ-bar. Arms extended over face/forehead. Lower bar by bending elbows to forehead level, extend back up. Spotter recommended.

name: Barbell Snatch
setupNotes: Barbell on floor, very wide grip. Explosive pull from floor, pull body under bar, catch overhead with straight arms in squat. Stand up. Technical lift.

name: Barbell Thruster
setupNotes: Barbell in front rack position on shoulders, feet shoulder-width. Squat to full depth, then drive up explosively and press the bar to overhead lockout in one fluid motion. Full-body power — legs, shoulders and core.

name: Barbell Upright Row
setupNotes: Standing, grip barbell at hip width. Pull straight up along body to chin level, elbows high.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
setupNotes: Seated, forearms resting on thighs or preacher bench, palms up. Barbell in hands. Curl wrists upward, controlled lower. Let bar roll to fingers for extra range.

name: Battle Ropes — Alternating Waves
setupNotes: Stand with knees slightly bent, one rope end in each hand. Alternate arms creating continuous waves in rope. Full body cardio.

name: Battle Ropes — Kneeling Power Slam
setupNotes: Kneel on mat, both rope ends in hands. Raise both arms overhead then slam ropes down together. Removes legs, isolates upper body and core power.

name: Battle Ropes — Kneeling Waves
setupNotes: Kneel on mat, one rope end in each hand. Alternating waves from kneeling position. Removes legs, isolates upper body and core.

name: Battle Ropes — Power Slam
setupNotes: Stand with knees slightly bent, both rope ends. Raise both arms overhead then slam ropes down together. Squat with slam. Full body power.

name: Bear Crawl
setupNotes: On hands and feet (not knees), knees hovering just off ground. Crawl forward moving opposite hand and foot together. Core and full body.

name: Behind-the-Back Barbell Wrist Curl
setupNotes: Standing, barbell held behind body at arms length, palms facing back. Curl wrists up, controlled lower. Standing allows heavier loads.

name: Behind-the-Back Cable Curl
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing away from machine, arm extended behind. Curl forward against cable for unique stretch-focused angle.

name: Behind-the-Back Cable Lateral Raise
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle passed behind back. Stand sideways. Raise arm to side — cable behind body keeps tension through full range.

name: Belt Squat
setupNotes: Belt squat machine. Attach belt around hips to weight, stand on elevated platforms. Squat down and up — zero spinal loading. Quad and glute focus.

name: Bench Dip — Standard
setupNotes: Hands on edge of bench behind body, fingers forward. Feet on floor, legs extended or bent. Lower body by bending elbows, press back up.

name: Bench Dip — Weighted
setupNotes: Same as standard bench dip. Place weight plate on lap for additional resistance. Spotter may assist with plate placement.

name: Bench Press — Smith Machine
setupNotes: Smith machine bar set at chest level over a flat bench. Lie supine, feet flat, shoulder blades retracted. Unrack with a small wrist twist, lower bar to mid-chest, press to lockout. Fixed bar path keeps form locked in.

name: Bench-Supported One-Arm Row
setupNotes: Incline bench at ~30 degrees, chest against pad. Dumbbell in one side hand — row to one side hip, elbow tracking close to body. Bench prevents momentum for strict lat work.

name: Bench-Supported One-Arm Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: Incline bench at ~30 degrees, chest against pad. Dumbbell in left hand — row to left hip, elbow tracking close to body. Bench prevents momentum for strict lat work.

name: Bench-Supported One-Arm Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: Incline bench at ~30 degrees, chest against pad. Dumbbell in right hand — row to right hip, elbow tracking close to body. Bench prevents momentum for strict lat work.

name: Bicycle Crunch — Slow Tempo
setupNotes: Lie face up, hands behind head, shoulders lifted. Slowly twist one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg — 3–4 seconds per side. Full rotation through the torso — maximises oblique time under tension.

name: Bicycle Crunch — Standard
setupNotes: Lie face up, hands behind head (don't pull neck). Lift shoulders, twist right elbow to left knee while extending right leg. Alternate continuously.

name: Bird Dog — Band-Resisted
setupNotes: Kneeling bird-dog stance with a light resistance band running from the one hand to the the other foot. Extend the one arm and the other leg until the band is taut, hold, return. Band adds resistance and instability to the diagonal pattern.

name: Bird Dog — Band-Resisted — Left
setupNotes: Kneeling bird-dog stance with a light resistance band running from the left hand to the right foot. Extend the left arm and right leg until the band is taut, hold, return. Band adds resistance and instability to the diagonal pattern.

name: Bird Dog — Band-Resisted — Right
setupNotes: Kneeling bird-dog stance with a light resistance band running from the right hand to the left foot. Extend the right arm and left leg until the band is taut, hold, return. Band adds resistance and instability to the diagonal pattern.

name: Bird Dog — From Push-Up Position
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. Extend the one arm forward and the the other leg back simultaneously, hold briefly without letting the hips rotate. Return. Much harder than the kneeling version.

name: Bird Dog — From Push-Up Position — Left
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. Extend the left arm forward and the right leg back simultaneously, hold briefly without letting the hips rotate. Return. Much harder than the kneeling version.

name: Bird Dog — From Push-Up Position — Right
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. Extend the right arm forward and the left leg back simultaneously, hold briefly without letting the hips rotate. Return. Much harder than the kneeling version.

name: Bird Dog Hold
setupNotes: On hands and knees, spine neutral. Extend the left arm forward and the right leg back simultaneously until both are parallel to the floor. Brace the core, hold briefly, return. Trains anti-extension and balance.

name: Bird Dog Row (Weighted)
setupNotes: Kneeling bird-dog stance with a dumbbell in the one hand. Extend the the other leg back, then row the one side dumbbell to the hip — keeping the hips square and core braced. Lower the dumbbell, return. Combines anti-rotation with a unilateral row.

name: Bird Dog Row (Weighted) — Left Arm
setupNotes: Kneeling bird-dog stance with a dumbbell in the left hand. Extend the right leg back, then row the left dumbbell to the hip — keeping the hips square and core braced. Lower the dumbbell, return. Combines anti-rotation with a unilateral row.

name: Bird Dog Row (Weighted) — Right Arm
setupNotes: Kneeling bird-dog stance with a dumbbell in the right hand. Extend the left leg back, then row the right dumbbell to the hip — keeping the hips square and core braced. Lower the dumbbell, return. Combines anti-rotation with a unilateral row.

name: Bird Dog — Standard
setupNotes: On hands and knees, spine neutral. Extend the one arm forward and the the other leg back simultaneously until both are parallel to the floor. Brace the core, hold briefly, return. Trains anti-extension and balance.

name: Bird Dog — Standard — Left
setupNotes: On hands and knees, spine neutral. Extend the left arm forward and the right leg back simultaneously until both are parallel to the floor. Brace the core, hold briefly, return. Trains anti-extension and balance.

name: Bird Dog — Standard — Right
setupNotes: On hands and knees, spine neutral. Extend the right arm forward and the left leg back simultaneously until both are parallel to the floor. Brace the core, hold briefly, return. Trains anti-extension and balance.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise on Step
setupNotes: Standing on edge of step or platform (no additional weight). Rise onto toes, controlled lower below platform level for full stretch. Both feet.

name: Bodyweight Lateral Lunge
setupNotes: Standing, step wide to one side, bend stepping leg, keep other leg straight. Push off to return. Using bodyweight.

name: Bodyweight Squat
setupNotes: Standing, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Arms forward for balance. Squat down to parallel or below. Drive up through heels.

name: Bodyweight Step-Up
setupNotes: Sturdy chair, bench, or staircase step. Place one foot fully on surface. Drive through one side heel to stand tall on top. Step down controlled. All reps on one leg.

name: Bodyweight Step-Up — Left Leg
setupNotes: Sturdy chair, bench, or staircase step. Place left foot fully on surface. Drive through left heel to stand tall on top. Step down controlled. All reps on left leg.

name: Bodyweight Step-Up — Right Leg
setupNotes: Sturdy chair, bench, or staircase step. Place right foot fully on surface. Drive through right heel to stand tall on top. Step down controlled. All reps on right leg.

name: BOSU Ball Dead Bug
setupNotes: Lie face up on BOSU ball (dome up) for added instability. Perform dead bug arm/leg extensions. BOSU challenges balance and core control.

name: Box Jump Squat
setupNotes: Stand facing sturdy plyo box or platform. Squat, swing arms, jump onto box landing softly in squat. Step down. Adjust box height to ability.

name: Box Squat — Barbell
setupNotes: Power rack with box or bench behind you at parallel-depth. Bar on back. Sit back to box, brief pause, drive up explosively. Controlled descent.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench, barbell racked across the upper back. Lower into a split squat until the one side front thigh is parallel, then drive through the one side heel to stand. Trains the one side quad and glute under spinal load.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench, barbell racked across the upper back. Lower into a split squat until the left front thigh is parallel, then drive through the left heel to stand. Trains the left quad and glute under spinal load.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack — Paused
setupNotes: Barbell racked across the upper back, rear foot elevated on a bench behind you and the working foot planted ahead. Lower into a split squat until the front thigh is parallel, then hold a deliberate 1-2 second pause at the bottom to kill the stretch reflex before driving up through the front heel. The paused tempo builds bottom-position strength in the front-leg quad and glute under spinal load.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack — Paused — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench, left foot forward, barbell racked across the upper back. Lower until the left front thigh is parallel, hold a deliberate 1-2 second pause at the bottom to kill the stretch reflex, then drive through the left heel to stand. The paused tempo builds bottom-position strength in the left quad and glute under spinal load.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack — Paused

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack — Paused — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot rear-elevated on a bench, right foot forward, barbell racked across the upper back. Lower until the right front thigh is parallel, hold a deliberate 1-2 second pause at the bottom to kill the stretch reflex, then drive through the right heel to stand. The paused tempo builds bottom-position strength in the right quad and glute under spinal load.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack — Paused

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot rear-elevated on a bench, barbell racked across the upper back. Lower into a split squat until the right front thigh is parallel, then drive through the right heel to stand. Trains the right quad and glute under spinal load.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Front Rack
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench, barbell in the front rack across the shoulders, elbows up. Lower until the one side front thigh is parallel, drive through the one side heel to stand. Front rack forces an upright torso — heavier left-quad emphasis.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Front Rack — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench, barbell in the front rack across the shoulders, elbows up. Lower until the left front thigh is parallel, drive through the left heel to stand. Front rack forces an upright torso — heavier left-quad emphasis.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Front Rack

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Front Rack — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot rear-elevated on a bench, barbell in the front rack across the shoulders, elbows up. Lower until the right front thigh is parallel, drive through the right heel to stand. Front rack forces an upright torso — heavier right-quad emphasis.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Front Rack

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Bodyweight
setupNotes: the other foot rear-elevated on a chair or low bench, one foot 2–3 feet forward. Lower until the one side front thigh is parallel to the floor, drive through the one side heel to return. Bodyweight only — clean trainer for the one side quad and glute.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Bodyweight — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a chair or low bench, left foot 2–3 feet forward. Lower until the left front thigh is parallel to the floor, drive through the left heel to return. Bodyweight only — clean trainer for the left quad and glute.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Bodyweight — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot rear-elevated on a chair or low bench, right foot 2–3 feet forward. Lower until the right front thigh is parallel to the floor, drive through the right heel to return. Bodyweight only — clean trainer for the right quad and glute.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Right foot laces-down on a bench behind you, one side foot 2–3 feet forward, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Lower until the one side thigh is parallel. Drive up through the front heel — quad and glute emphasis on the one side leg.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Dumbbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot laces-down on a bench behind you, left foot 2–3 feet forward, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Lower until the left thigh is parallel. Drive up through the front heel — quad and glute emphasis on the left leg.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Dumbbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot laces-down on a bench behind you, right foot 2–3 feet forward, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Lower until the right thigh is parallel. Drive up through the front heel — quad and glute emphasis on the right leg.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Front Foot Elevated
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench AND one side front foot on a small plate or step. Lower into the deficit split squat — one side front thigh well below parallel — then drive up through the one side heel. Increased range loads the one side glute deeply.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Front Foot Elevated — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench AND left front foot on a small plate or step. Lower into the deficit split squat — left front thigh well below parallel — then drive up through the left heel. Increased range loads the left glute deeply.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Front Foot Elevated

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Front Foot Elevated — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot rear-elevated on a bench AND right front foot on a small plate or step. Lower into the deficit split squat — right front thigh well below parallel — then drive up through the right heel. Increased range loads the right glute deeply.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Front Foot Elevated

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Jump (Plyo)
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench, bodyweight only. Lower into a split squat then explode upward off the one side foot, landing softly back into the split position. Re-stabilise before the next rep. Plyometric power through the one side leg.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Jump (Plyo) — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench, bodyweight only. Lower into a split squat then explode upward off the left foot, landing softly back into the split position. Re-stabilise before the next rep. Plyometric power through the left leg.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Jump (Plyo) — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot rear-elevated on a bench, bodyweight only. Lower into a split squat then explode upward off the right foot, landing softly back into the split position. Re-stabilise before the next rep. Plyometric power through the right leg.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Paused
setupNotes: Right foot on a bench behind you, one side foot forward, dumbbells at sides or barbell on back. Lower until the one side thigh is parallel and hold 2–3 seconds before driving up. Removes stretch reflex — builds bottom-position strength.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Paused — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot on a bench behind you, left foot forward, dumbbells at sides or barbell on back. Lower until the left thigh is parallel and hold 2–3 seconds before driving up. Removes stretch reflex — builds bottom-position strength.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Paused — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot on a bench behind you, right foot forward, dumbbells at sides or barbell on back. Lower until the right thigh is parallel and hold 2–3 seconds before driving up. Removes stretch reflex — builds bottom-position strength.

name: Burpee
setupNotes: Standing, squat down placing hands on floor. Jump feet back to plank, perform push-up (optional), jump feet to hands, jump up with arms overhead. Full body.

name: Butt Kicks
setupNotes: Standing, jog in place kicking heels up to touch glutes. Pump arms naturally. Light bounce on balls of feet. Hamstring warm-up and cardio.

name: Cable Biceps Curl — Straight Bar
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, straight bar or EZ-bar attachment. Stand facing machine, curl bar to shoulders. Constant cable tension throughout.

name: Cable Biceps Curl — Straight Bar — Narrow Closed Grip
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, straight bar attachment. Stand facing the machine, hands narrower than shoulder-width with a closed (thumb-around) grip. Curl bar to shoulders keeping elbows pinned to ribs — narrow grip emphasises the long head of the biceps.

name: Cable Chest Fly — High
setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulley set at high position. D-handles attached. Step forward to create tension, slight bend in elbows throughout.

name: Cable Chest Fly — Low
setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulley set at low position. D-handles attached. Step forward to create tension, slight bend in elbows throughout.

name: Cable Chest Fly — Mid
setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulley set at mid position. D-handles attached. Step forward to create tension, slight bend in elbows throughout.

name: Cable Chest Press — High
setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulleys set at high position with D-handles. Stand facing away in a split stance, handles at shoulder level. Press both handles forward and slightly down, meeting at midline — targets the lower chest fibres.

name: Cable Chest Press — Low
setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulleys set at low position with D-handles. Stand facing away in a split stance, handles by the hips. Press both handles forward and slightly up, meeting at midline above chest — targets the upper chest and front delts.

name: Cable Chest Press — Mid
setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulleys set at mid (chest) position with D-handles. Stand facing away in a split stance, handles at chest level. Press both handles forward to full extension, meeting at midline — targets the mid-chest with constant cable tension.

name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension — Rope
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, rope attachment. Face away from machine, arms overhead. Extend forward from behind head to full lockout.

name: Cable Preacher Curl
setupNotes: Preacher bench positioned in front of low cable pulley. EZ-bar or straight bar attachment. Constant tension through full range of motion.

name: Cable Pull-Through
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, rope attachment. Face away from machine, straddle cable. Hinge at hips, let rope pull through legs, then drive hips forward to standing.

name: Cable Rope Curl
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, rope attachment. Stand facing machine, grip rope ends. Curl up and twist rope outward at top for peak contraction.

name: Cable Rope Curl — Outside
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, rope attachment. Stand facing the machine, grip the rope ends with palms turned outward and rope splayed wider than the hands. Curl up driving the rope ends out to the sides at the top — peak contraction with extra supination. Targets biceps short head and brachialis.

name: Cable Russian Twist
setupNotes: Seated or standing, cable at chest height with D-handle or rope. Hold at chest, rotate torso side to side against cable resistance.

name: Cable Russian Twist — Left
setupNotes: Cable at chest height with D-handle or rope. Stand or kneel with the right side toward the stack, both hands on the handle in front of the chest. Rotate the torso to the left against cable resistance, then return under control. Hips and feet stay planted — rotation comes from the trunk.

name: Cable Russian Twist — Right
setupNotes: Cable at chest height with D-handle or rope. Stand or kneel with the left side toward the stack, both hands on the handle in front of the chest. Rotate the torso to the right against cable resistance, then return under control. Hips and feet stay planted — rotation comes from the trunk.

name: Cable Shrug
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, straight bar or rope attachment. Stand upright, arms straight. Shrug shoulders upward against cable resistance.

name: Cable Upright Row
setupNotes: Standing, grip cable at hip width. Pull straight up along body to chin level, elbows high.

name: Cable Woodchop — High-to-Low
setupNotes: Cable at the highest pulley with rope or D-handle. Stand one side side toward the stack, both hands on the handle overhead-right. Pull diagonally across the body down to the low-left, rotating through the torso and pivoting the right foot. Trains rotational power and oblique control.

name: Cable Woodchop — High-to-Low — Left
setupNotes: Cable at the highest pulley with rope or D-handle. Stand left side toward the stack, both hands on the handle overhead-right. Pull diagonally across the body down to the low-left, rotating through the torso and pivoting the right foot. Trains rotational power and oblique control.

name: Cable Woodchop — High-to-Low — Right
setupNotes: Cable at the highest pulley with rope or D-handle. Stand right side toward the stack, both hands on the handle overhead-left. Pull diagonally across the body down to the low-right, rotating through the torso and pivoting the left foot. Trains rotational power and oblique control.

name: Cable Woodchop — Horizontal
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Stand sideways, rotate torso horizontally, pulling cable across body. Feet stay planted, rotation at trunk only.

name: Cable Woodchop — Horizontal — Left
setupNotes: Cable at chest height with rope or D-handle. Stand right side toward the stack, both hands on the handle. Rotate the torso horizontally and pull the handle across the body to the left, pivoting the right foot. Feet planted, rotation from the trunk — trains horizontal rotational power.

name: Cable Woodchop — Horizontal — Right
setupNotes: Cable at chest height with rope or D-handle. Stand left side toward the stack, both hands on the handle. Rotate the torso horizontally and pull the handle across the body to the right, pivoting the left foot. Feet planted, rotation from the trunk — trains horizontal rotational power.

name: Cable Woodchop — Low-to-High
setupNotes: Cable at the lowest pulley with rope or D-handle. Stand one side side toward the stack, both hands on the handle at the low-right hip. Drive diagonally up and across to overhead-left, extending the hips and rotating through the torso. Power from legs and core.

name: Cable Woodchop — Low-to-High — Left
setupNotes: Cable at the lowest pulley with rope or D-handle. Stand left side toward the stack, both hands on the handle at the low-right hip. Drive diagonally up and across to overhead-left, extending the hips and rotating through the torso. Power from legs and core.

name: Cable Woodchop — Low-to-High — Right
setupNotes: Cable at the lowest pulley with rope or D-handle. Stand right side toward the stack, both hands on the handle at the low-left hip. Drive diagonally up and across to overhead-right, extending the hips and rotating through the torso. Power from legs and core.

name: Calf Press on Leg Press
setupNotes: Leg press machine, toes only on bottom edge of platform. Extend ankles (plantar flex) to press weight, controlled return. Full range of motion.

name: Calf Stretch — Wall
setupNotes: Face a wall in a split stance — one side foot back with the heel pressed to the floor, right foot forward with the knee bent. Lean the hips toward the wall until the one side calf stretches. Hold. Targets the one side gastrocnemius.

name: Calf Stretch — Wall (Left Leg)
setupNotes: Face a wall in a split stance — left foot back with the heel pressed to the floor, right foot forward with the knee bent. Lean the hips toward the wall until the left calf stretches. Hold. Targets the left gastrocnemius.

name: Calf Stretch — Wall (Right Leg)
setupNotes: Face a wall in a split stance — right foot back with the heel pressed to the floor, left foot forward with the knee bent. Lean the hips toward the wall until the right calf stretches. Hold. Targets the right gastrocnemius.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
setupNotes: Captain's chair / vertical knee raise station. Forearms on pads, back against support. Raise knees to chest, controlled lower.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise — Oblique
setupNotes: Captain's chair / vertical knee-raise station. Forearms on the pads, back flat against the support. Raise the knees toward one shoulder, twisting the pelvis to that side, then alternate. Controlled tempo — emphasises the obliques over the rectus abdominis.

name: Cat-Cow
setupNotes: On hands and knees. Alternate between arching back (cow — belly drops) and rounding back (cat — belly lifts). Coordinate with breathing.

name: Chair Dip
setupNotes: Hands on edge of sturdy chair behind body, fingers forward. Feet on floor. Lower by bending elbows, press back up. Triceps focus.

name: Chest Dip
setupNotes: Parallel bar dip station. Lean torso forward ~30 degrees, elbows flare slightly out. Wider grip emphasises chest over triceps.

name: Chest Stretch — Doorway
setupNotes: Stand in a doorway, one side forearm against the frame with the elbow at 90 degrees and shoulder height. Step the one side foot through the doorway and rotate the chest away from the arm until a stretch is felt across the one side pec and front shoulder. Hold.

name: Chest Stretch — Doorway — Left
setupNotes: Stand in a doorway, left forearm against the frame with the elbow at 90 degrees and shoulder height. Step the left foot through the doorway and rotate the chest away from the arm until a stretch is felt across the left pec and front shoulder. Hold.

name: Chest Stretch — Doorway — Right
setupNotes: Stand in a doorway, right forearm against the frame with the elbow at 90 degrees and shoulder height. Step the right foot through the doorway and rotate the chest away from the arm until a stretch is felt across the right pec and front shoulder. Hold.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
setupNotes: Incline bench at ~30-45 degrees, chest against pad. Dumbbell in each hand. Row both dumbbells simultaneously. No momentum.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Chest-supported T-bar machine. Lie face down on pad. Grip handles neutral, row to chest. Support prevents cheating.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Chest-supported T-bar machine. Lie face down on pad. Grip handles overhand, row to chest. Support prevents cheating.

name: Child's Pose
setupNotes: Kneel on mat, sit back on heels, extend arms forward on floor. Forehead rests on ground. Deep breathing. Stretches back, lats, and hips.

name: Chin-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, underhand (supinated) grip at shoulder-width. Pull chin over bar, squeezing biceps and lats. Full hang at bottom.

name: Clamshell — Banded
setupNotes: Lie on the the other side with a mini band looped just above the knees, knees bent to 90 degrees and feet stacked. Open the one side (top) knee against the band's resistance, squeezing the one side glute medius. Lower under control.

name: Clamshell — Banded — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the right side with a mini band looped just above the knees, knees bent to 90 degrees and feet stacked. Open the left (top) knee against the band's resistance, squeezing the left glute medius. Lower under control.

name: Clamshell — Banded — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the left side with a mini band looped just above the knees, knees bent to 90 degrees and feet stacked. Open the right (top) knee against the band's resistance, squeezing the right glute medius. Lower under control.

name: Clamshell — Standard
setupNotes: Lie on the the other side, knees bent to 90 degrees, feet stacked together. Keep the feet touching and open the one side (top) knee upward like a clamshell, squeezing the one side glute medius. Lower under control.

name: Clamshell — Standard — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the right side, knees bent to 90 degrees, feet stacked together. Keep the feet touching and open the left (top) knee upward like a clamshell, squeezing the left glute medius. Lower under control.

name: Clamshell — Standard — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the left side, knees bent to 90 degrees, feet stacked together. Keep the feet touching and open the right (top) knee upward like a clamshell, squeezing the right glute medius. Lower under control.

name: Clap Push-Up
setupNotes: Standard push-up position on firm floor. Push explosively so hands leave ground, clap, land softly with bent elbows. Plyometric power.

name: Clean and Press
setupNotes: Perform a power clean from floor to front rack, then press (or push press) overhead to lockout. Lower bar and repeat. Full body compound.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press — Barbell
setupNotes: Flat bench, barbell with hands 12-14 inches apart (inside shoulder-width). Lower bar to lower chest, elbows close to body. Press to lockout.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press — Dumbbell (Neutral)
setupNotes: Flat bench, dumbbells pressed together with neutral grip above chest. Press up keeping dumbbells touching. Elbows close to body.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press — Smith Machine
setupNotes: Flat bench in Smith machine. Narrow grip. Lower to lower chest with elbows tucked, press to lockout. Machine guides path.

name: Close-Grip Decline Dumbbell Bench Press — Neutral
setupNotes: Decline bench, feet secured. Press dumbbells with a neutral (palms-facing) grip and dumbbells touching above lower chest. Lower under control until upper arms touch ribs, press back up keeping dumbbells together. Neutral close grip is shoulder-friendly and emphasises lower chest and triceps.

name: Close-Grip Incline Dumbbell Bench Press — Neutral
setupNotes: Incline bench (30-45 degrees). Press dumbbells with a neutral (palms-facing) grip and dumbbells touching above the upper chest. Lower under control until upper arms touch ribs, press back up keeping dumbbells together. Neutral close grip is shoulder-friendly and emphasises upper chest and triceps.

name: Close-Grip Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, overhand grip with hands touching or 6 inches apart. Pull chin over bar. More bicep and lower lat involvement.

name: Commando Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, hands staggered one in front of the other (perpendicular grip). Pull head to one side of bar, alternate sides.

name: Concentration Curl — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on bench, one side elbow braced against inner one side thigh. Dumbbell in one side hand hanging toward the floor — curl up in strict isolation, squeezing the biceps at the top. No torso movement.

name: Concentration Curl — Seated — Left Arm
setupNotes: Seated on bench, left elbow braced against inner left thigh. Dumbbell in left hand hanging toward the floor — curl up in strict isolation, squeezing the biceps at the top. No torso movement.

name: Concentration Curl — Seated — Right Arm
setupNotes: Seated on bench, right elbow braced against inner right thigh. Dumbbell in right hand hanging toward the floor — curl up in strict isolation, squeezing the biceps at the top. No torso movement.

name: Conventional Barbell Deadlift
setupNotes: Barbell on floor, feet hip-width (conventional stance). Mixed or double-overhand grip just outside knees. Flat back, chest up — drive through heels to lockout.

name: Couch Stretch
setupNotes: Kneel facing away from a wall with the one side shin pressed up against it (toes pointing up), the other foot forward in a lunge. Tuck the pelvis and push the hips forward, staying tall. Intense stretch of the one side quad and hip flexor.

name: Couch Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Kneel facing away from a wall with the left shin pressed up against it (toes pointing up), right foot forward in a lunge. Tuck the pelvis and push the hips forward, staying tall. Intense stretch of the left quad and hip flexor.

name: Couch Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Kneel facing away from a wall with the right shin pressed up against it (toes pointing up), left foot forward in a lunge. Tuck the pelvis and push the hips forward, staying tall. Intense stretch of the right quad and hip flexor.

name: Cross-Body Arm Swings
setupNotes: Standing, swing both arms horizontally across body in alternating cross pattern. Opens chest and warms up shoulders and pecs.

name: Cross-Body Biceps Curl
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbell in each hand. Curl one dumbbell across the body toward the opposite shoulder with supinated grip — palm up at top. Targets the long head of the biceps. Alternate arms.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
setupNotes: Standing, curl dumbbell across body toward opposite shoulder with neutral grip. Targets brachialis and brachioradialis. Alternate arms.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on a bench, dumbbell in each hand. Curl one dumbbell across the body toward the opposite shoulder with neutral grip. Targets brachialis and brachioradialis. Alternate arms.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
setupNotes: Standing tall, bring the one side arm straight across the chest. Hook the right forearm under the one side elbow and pull the one side arm closer to the body. Hold. Stretches the one side rear delt and upper back.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Standing tall, bring the left arm straight across the chest. Hook the right forearm under the left elbow and pull the left arm closer to the body. Hold. Stretches the left rear delt and upper back.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Standing tall, bring the right arm straight across the chest. Hook the left forearm under the right elbow and pull the right arm closer to the body. Hold. Stretches the right rear delt and upper back.

name: Cuban Rotation — Disk — Front
setupNotes: Standing, weight plate held at hip in one hand. Pull elbow up so upper arm is parallel to floor and elbow is bent 90 degrees — forearm hanging down. Rotate forearm up until it points to the ceiling, controlled lower. Light load — pure rotator cuff work.

name: Cuban Rotation — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, elbows at 90 degrees at shoulder height. Rotate forearms from pointing down to pointing up. Prehab / rotator cuff work.

name: Curtsy Lunge — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Standing tall. Step the one foot behind and across the the other leg, lowering until the the other side thigh is parallel to the floor. Drive through the the other side heel to return to standing. Targets the glute medius.

name: Curtsy Lunge — Bodyweight — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall. Step the left foot behind and across the right leg, lowering until the right thigh is parallel to the floor. Drive through the right heel to return to standing. Targets the glute medius.

name: Curtsy Lunge — Bodyweight — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall. Step the right foot behind and across the left leg, lowering until the left thigh is parallel to the floor. Drive through the left heel to return to standing. Targets the glute medius.

name: Dead Bug — Banded
setupNotes: Standard dead bug position. Light resistance band looped around hands and/or feet. Band tension adds core demand through full range.

name: Dead Bug — Slow Tempo
setupNotes: Same position as standard dead bug. Very slow controlled extension (4-5 seconds out, 4-5 seconds back). Focus on maintaining lower back contact with floor.

name: Dead Bug — Standard
setupNotes: Lie face up, arms straight toward ceiling, knees bent 90 degrees (tabletop). Extend opposite arm/leg toward floor, return, alternate. Press lower back into floor.

name: Dead Bug — Weighted
setupNotes: Standard dead bug position holding light dumbbell in hands overhead. Extend limbs with control. Added load on core stabilisers.

name: Dead Bug with Physio Ball
setupNotes: Lie face up, squeeze physio ball between hands and knees. Extend opposite arm and leg while maintaining ball pressure with other limbs.

name: Dead Hang
setupNotes: Pull-up bar at height allowing full hang without feet touching floor. Overhand grip, relax shoulders, decompress spine. Timed hold.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Decline bench inside power rack, feet secured. Bar at chest height, spotter recommended. Shoulder blades retracted. Unrack, lower bar to lower chest — press up to lockout.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press — Narrow-Close Grip
setupNotes: Decline bench inside power rack, feet secured. Hands narrower than shoulders on the bar. Unrack, lower bar to lower chest with elbows tucked, press up to lockout — emphasises triceps and lower-chest insertion.

name: Decline Crunch
setupNotes: Decline bench, feet hooked under pads. Lie back, hands behind head or across chest. Crunch up, lifting shoulder blades off bench. Controlled lower.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Decline bench with dumbbell rack nearby. Start with dumbbells on thighs, kick up to pressing position. Retract shoulder blades.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press — Close Grip Neutral
setupNotes: Decline bench, dumbbells held with neutral grip (palms facing each other) above lower chest. Lower under control until upper arms touch ribs, press back up keeping dumbbells close together. Neutral grip is shoulder-friendly and shifts emphasis to lower chest and triceps.

name: Decline Dumbbell Chest Fly
setupNotes: Decline bench with moderate dumbbells. Arms extended above chest, slight elbow bend. Lower in arc until stretch is felt.

name: Decline Machine Chest Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Decline chest press machine — adjust seat so handles align with lower chest. Grip overhand with palms down, back against pad, feet flat. Press handles forward and slightly down — targets lower chest fibres.

name: Decline Push-Up
setupNotes: Feet elevated on bench, box, or chair. Hands on floor shoulder-width. Body in straight line from feet to head. Lower chest to floor, press up.

name: Decline Reverse Crunch
setupNotes: Decline bench, grip bench above head. Bring knees toward chest by lifting hips off bench. Controlled lower. Lower ab emphasis.

name: Decline Slow Tempo Push-Up
setupNotes: Feet elevated on bench or box, hands on floor shoulder-width, body in straight line. Lower chest toward floor for 3–4 seconds, pause 1 second at bottom, press up with control. Tempo work emphasises upper chest and shoulders.

name: Decline Twisting Crunch
setupNotes: Same decline bench setup. Crunch up with rotation — right elbow toward left knee, alternate. Engages obliques with rectus abdominis.

name: Decline Twisting Crunch — Weighted
setupNotes: Same decline bench setup, holding a plate or dumbbell at the chest. Crunch up with rotation — right elbow toward left knee, alternate. Added load amplifies oblique engagement.

name: Diamond Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands on floor with index fingers and thumbs touching (diamond shape). Body in straight line. Lower chest to hands, press up. Triceps-dominant.

name: Diaphragmatic Breathing — Supine
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees bent, feet flat. One hand on chest, one on belly. Breathe deeply into belly (belly rises), chest stays still. Slow exhale.

name: Donkey Kick
setupNotes: On hands and knees in quadruped, mat under knees. Drive one side heel toward the ceiling with knee bent 90 degrees, squeezing the glute at top. Controlled return — isolates the one side glute.

name: Donkey Kick — Left
setupNotes: On hands and knees in quadruped, mat under knees. Drive left heel toward the ceiling with knee bent 90 degrees, squeezing the glute at top. Controlled return — isolates the left glute.

name: Donkey Kick — Right
setupNotes: On hands and knees in quadruped, mat under knees. Drive right heel toward the ceiling with knee bent 90 degrees, squeezing the glute at top. Controlled return — isolates the right glute.

name: Double-Arm Landmine Chest Press
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner. Stand in a staggered stance, both hands cupped around the end of the bar held at the chest. Press the bar forward and up in a roughly horizontal arc to full extension, then lower under control — drives the chest (pecs) with front-delt and triceps assistance.

name: Double-Arm Landmine Shoulder Press
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment, staggered stance. Grip end of bar at chest with both hands. Press upward in an arc until arms are extended — lower slowly.

name: Drag Curl — Barbell
setupNotes: Standing, barbell at hip level. Instead of curling in arc, drag bar up body by pulling elbows straight back. Bar stays in contact with torso.

name: Dragon Flag
setupNotes: Lie on flat bench, grip bench behind head. Lift entire body off bench in straight line, lower under control without touching bench. Advanced core.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
setupNotes: Lie on floor with dumbbell. Knees bent, feet flat. Upper arms touch floor at bottom of each rep.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press — Close Grip Neutral
setupNotes: Lie on floor, knees bent, dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing each other) over chest. Lower until upper arms touch the floor, press back up keeping dumbbells close. Floor stops range of motion — easy on shoulders, heavy emphasis on triceps and lockout.

name: Dumbbell Good Morning
setupNotes: Hold dumbbells at shoulders or behind head. Feet hip-width apart. Hinge at hips, push hips back, lower torso to roughly parallel — stand up by driving hips forward.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
setupNotes: Standing, step wide to one side, bend stepping leg, keep other leg straight. Push off to return. Using dumbbell.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge — Left Side
setupNotes: Standing tall with a dumbbell in each hand. Step wide to the left side, push hips back and bend the left knee — right leg stays straight, both feet flat. Push off the left foot to return. Trains adductors, glutes and hip mobility.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge — Right Side
setupNotes: Standing tall with a dumbbell in each hand. Step wide to the right side, push hips back and bend the right knee — left leg stays straight, both feet flat. Push off the right foot to return. Trains adductors, glutes and hip mobility.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
setupNotes: Preacher curl bench, dumbbell in one hand. Upper arm flat on pad. Curl up, squeeze at top, slow eccentric. Full stretch at bottom.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl — Alternating
setupNotes: Preacher curl bench, dumbbell in each hand. Both upper arms flat on pad. Curl one arm at a time, squeeze at top, slow eccentric before the other side curls. Full stretch at bottom.

name: Dumbbell Row
setupNotes: Standing, hinge at hips with flat back to roughly 45 degrees, dumbbell in each hand hanging below shoulders with neutral grip. Row both dumbbells to the ribcage, elbows close to body, squeeze the lats at the top. Controlled lower — no momentum.

name: Dumbbell Row — Overhand
setupNotes: Standing, hinge at hips with flat back, dumbbell in each hand with overhand grip (palms facing back). Row both dumbbells toward the lower ribs with elbows flared out. Overhand grip biases upper back, rear delts and rhomboids over lats.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
setupNotes: Standing, heavy dumbbells at sides. Shrug shoulders up toward ears, hold 1 second at top. Keep arms straight throughout.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
setupNotes: Flat bench, dumbbells with neutral grip above face. Lower dumbbells by bending elbows to beside ears, extend back up.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbells held overhead with neutral grip, arms extended. Bend the elbows to lower the dumbbells beside the ears, elbows pinned forward and pointing up. Extend back up to lockout. Brace the core — standing variant adds full-body stability demand.

name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
setupNotes: Standing on edge of step or plate, dumbbell in one hand, other hand for balance. Rise onto toes, controlled lower. Alternate hands.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
setupNotes: Dumbbells racked at shoulders with neutral grip, feet shoulder-width. Squat to full depth, then drive up explosively and press the dumbbells to overhead lockout in one fluid motion. Full-body power.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
setupNotes: Right hand and right knee on flat bench, one side foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell in one side hand, upper arm parallel to floor, elbow pinned to side. Extend one side forearm back to lockout, squeeze triceps. Controlled return.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback — Left Arm
setupNotes: Right hand and right knee on flat bench, left foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell in left hand, upper arm parallel to floor, elbow pinned to side. Extend left forearm back to lockout, squeeze triceps. Controlled return.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback — Right Arm
setupNotes: Left hand and left knee on flat bench, right foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell in right hand, upper arm parallel to floor, elbow pinned to side. Extend right forearm back to lockout, squeeze triceps. Controlled return.

name: Elliptical — Intervals
setupNotes: Elliptical machine. Alternate between high resistance/speed bursts and easy recovery. Use both handles for upper and lower body.

name: Elliptical — Reverse Pedal
setupNotes: Elliptical machine, pedal in reverse direction. Quad emphasis changes compared to forward motion. Grip handles for stability.

name: Elliptical — Steady
setupNotes: Elliptical machine. Feet on pedals, grip moving or stationary handles. Smooth pedalling motion. Moderate resistance, steady pace.

name: Explosive Push-Up
setupNotes: Standard push-up position on firm floor. Explode upward so hands leave the ground. Land softly with slight elbow bend. Advanced movement.

name: External Rotation — Band
setupNotes: Anchor a band at elbow height to the the other side. Stand with the the other side toward the anchor, hold the band in the one hand with the elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees. Rotate the forearm outward away from the body against the band. Trains the one side rotator cuff (infraspinatus/teres minor).

name: External Rotation — Band (Left Arm)
setupNotes: Anchor a band at elbow height to the right. Stand with the right side toward the anchor, hold the band in the left hand with the elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees. Rotate the forearm outward away from the body against the band. Trains the left rotator cuff (infraspinatus/teres minor).

name: External Rotation — Band (Right Arm)
setupNotes: Anchor a band at elbow height to the left. Stand with the left side toward the anchor, hold the band in the right hand with the elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees. Rotate the forearm outward away from the body against the band. Trains the right rotator cuff (infraspinatus/teres minor).

name: EZ-Bar Curl — Standing — Narrow Grip
setupNotes: Standing, EZ-bar with comfortable wrist angle. Narrow Grip position. Curl to shoulders, squeeze at top, controlled eccentric.

name: EZ-Bar Curl — Standing — Wide Grip
setupNotes: Standing, EZ-bar with comfortable wrist angle. Wide Grip position. Curl to shoulders, squeeze at top, controlled eccentric.

name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
setupNotes: Preacher curl bench, EZ-bar. Upper arms flat on pad, armpits at top of pad. Curl up, controlled lower — no momentum or bouncing at bottom.

name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
setupNotes: Flat or slight incline bench, EZ-bar. Grip at narrow angle. Lower to forehead, extend to lockout. EZ-bar reduces wrist strain.

name: EZ-Bar Upright Row
setupNotes: Standing, grip ez-bar at hip width. Pull straight up along body to chin level, elbows high.

name: Farmer's Walk
setupNotes: Standing, heavy dumbbell or farmer's walk handles in each hand at sides. Walk in straight line for distance or time. Tall posture, shoulders packed.

name: Fast Feet
setupNotes: Athletic stance, slightly bent knees. Rapid small steps in place, feet barely leaving ground. Fast as possible for prescribed time. Agility drill.

name: Fire Hydrant
setupNotes: Hands and knees position, spine neutral. Lift the one knee out to the side keeping the 90-degree bend, squeezing the glute at top. Controlled lower — targets the one side glute medius.

name: Fire Hydrant — Left
setupNotes: Hands and knees position, spine neutral. Lift the left knee out to the side keeping the 90-degree bend, squeezing the glute at top. Controlled lower — targets the left glute medius.

name: Fire Hydrant — Right
setupNotes: Hands and knees position, spine neutral. Lift the right knee out to the side keeping the 90-degree bend, squeezing the glute at top. Controlled lower — targets the right glute medius.

name: Flat Barbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Flat bench inside power rack or bench station. Bar at chest height, spotter recommended. Feet flat, shoulder blades retracted. Unrack, lower bar to mid-chest — press up to lockout.

name: Flat Dumbbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Flat bench with dumbbell rack nearby. Start with dumbbells on thighs, kick up to pressing position. Retract shoulder blades.

name: Flat Dumbbell Chest Fly
setupNotes: Flat bench with moderate dumbbells. Arms extended above chest, slight elbow bend. Lower in arc until stretch is felt.

name: Flat Machine Chest Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Flat chest press machine — adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest. Grip overhand with palms down, back against pad, feet flat. Press handles forward to full extension — targets chest with triceps assistance.

name: Flat Slow Tempo Push-Up
setupNotes: Standard push-up position — hands shoulder-width on floor, body in straight line. Lower for 3–4 seconds, pause 1 second at bottom, press up with control. Tempo work builds chest time-under-tension.

name: Flutter Kicks
setupNotes: Lie face up, legs extended ~6 inches off floor. Alternate small up/down kicks rapidly. Lower back pressed into floor. Core endurance.

name: Foam Roll — Calves
setupNotes: Sit on the floor with a foam roller under the one side calf, the other leg crossed over the one side for added pressure. Hands behind for support, lift the hips and roll from the Achilles up to just below the knee. Rotate the leg to hit medial and lateral fibres.

name: Foam Roll — Calves — Left
setupNotes: Sit on the floor with a foam roller under the left calf, right leg crossed over the left for added pressure. Hands behind for support, lift the hips and roll from the Achilles up to just below the knee. Rotate the leg to hit medial and lateral fibres.

name: Foam Roll — Calves — Right
setupNotes: Sit on the floor with a foam roller under the right calf, left leg crossed over the right for added pressure. Hands behind for support, lift the hips and roll from the Achilles up to just below the knee. Rotate the leg to hit medial and lateral fibres.

name: Foam Roll — Glutes
setupNotes: Sit on a foam roller, cross the one side ankle over the the other knee in a figure-4. Lean the weight toward the one side and roll slowly over the one side glute, pausing on tender spots. Targeted release of the one side glute and piriformis.

name: Foam Roll — Glutes — Left
setupNotes: Sit on a foam roller, cross the left ankle over the right knee in a figure-4. Lean the weight toward the left side and roll slowly over the left glute, pausing on tender spots. Targeted release of the left glute and piriformis.

name: Foam Roll — Glutes — Right
setupNotes: Sit on a foam roller, cross the right ankle over the left knee in a figure-4. Lean the weight toward the right side and roll slowly over the right glute, pausing on tender spots. Targeted release of the right glute and piriformis.

name: Foam Roll — Hamstrings
setupNotes: Sit on floor, foam roller under back of thighs. Roll from just above knee to sit bones. Hands behind for support. Cross legs for more pressure.

name: Foam Roll — IT Band
setupNotes: Lie on the one side with a foam roller under the one side outer thigh, the other leg crossed over for support. Roll slowly from just above the knee up to the hip. Releases the one side IT band — slow and tolerable.

name: Foam Roll — IT Band — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the left side with a foam roller under the left outer thigh, right leg crossed over for support. Roll slowly from just above the knee up to the hip. Releases the left IT band — slow and tolerable.

name: Foam Roll — IT Band — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the right side with a foam roller under the right outer thigh, left leg crossed over for support. Roll slowly from just above the knee up to the hip. Releases the right IT band — slow and tolerable.

name: Foam Roll — Lats
setupNotes: Lie on the one side with a foam roller under the one side armpit/lat area, one arm extended overhead. Roll slowly from the armpit down to the mid-ribcage, pausing on tender spots. Releases the one side lat.

name: Foam Roll — Lats — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the left side with a foam roller under the left armpit/lat area, left arm extended overhead. Roll slowly from the armpit down to the mid-ribcage, pausing on tender spots. Releases the left lat.

name: Foam Roll — Lats — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the right side with a foam roller under the right armpit/lat area, right arm extended overhead. Roll slowly from the armpit down to the mid-ribcage, pausing on tender spots. Releases the right lat.

name: Foam Roll — Quads
setupNotes: Lie face down, foam roller under front of thighs. Roll from just above knee to hip flexor. Support weight with forearms. Pause on tight spots.

name: Foam Roll — Upper Back
setupNotes: Foam roller on floor. Lie on roller positioned under upper back. Arms crossed on chest. Roll from mid-back to upper traps. Pause on tight spots.

name: Forearm Plank
setupNotes: Elbows on floor under shoulders, forearms flat. Body straight from head to heels. Engage entire core, breathe steadily. Timed hold.

name: Forward Lunge — Barbell
setupNotes: Standing tall with a barbell on the upper back, feet hip-width. Step the one side foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the one side heel to return to standing. Loads the one side quad and glute under barbell load.

name: Forward Lunge — Barbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall with a barbell on the upper back, feet hip-width. Step the left foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the left heel to return to standing. Loads the left quad and glute under barbell load.

name: Forward Lunge — Barbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall with a barbell on the upper back, feet hip-width. Step the right foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the right heel to return to standing. Loads the right quad and glute under barbell load.

name: Forward Lunge — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Standing tall, hands on hips or at sides. Step the one side foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the one side heel to return to standing. Loads the one side quad and glute.

name: Forward Lunge — Bodyweight — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall, hands on hips or at sides. Step the left foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the left heel to return to standing. Loads the left quad and glute.

name: Forward Lunge — Bodyweight — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall, hands on hips or at sides. Step the right foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the right heel to return to standing. Loads the right quad and glute.

name: Forward Lunge — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Step the one side foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the one side heel to return to standing. Loads the one side quad and glute.

name: Forward Lunge — Dumbbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Step the left foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the left heel to return to standing. Loads the left quad and glute.

name: Forward Lunge — Dumbbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Step the right foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the right heel to return to standing. Loads the right quad and glute.

name: Frog Pump
setupNotes: Lie face up, soles of feet together, knees out to sides (frog position). Drive hips up squeezing glutes. Minimises hamstring involvement.

name: Front Pause Squat — Barbell
setupNotes: Power rack, front squat setup. Descend to bottom position, hold for 2-3 seconds without relaxing tension, then drive up. Builds strength off bottom.

name: Front Raise — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbells in front of thighs. Raise one or both arms forward to shoulder height, palms down. Controlled lowering.

name: Front Raise — Plate
setupNotes: Standing, grip a weight plate at 3 and 9 o'clock. Raise to shoulder height with arms extended. Controlled tempo.

name: GHD Back Extension
setupNotes: Glute-Ham Developer machine. Pad at hip crease, feet anchored on platform. Hinge at hips, lower torso, extend back to horizontal or slight hyperextension.

name: Glute Bridge
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees bent, feet flat on floor hip-width. Drive hips up squeezing glutes at top. Lower controlled. Floor exercise.

name: Glute Bridge — Elevated
setupNotes: Same as standard bridge but feet placed on sturdy chair, bench, or step. Increases range of motion and difficulty.

name: Glute Bridge — Single-Leg
setupNotes: Lie face up, one foot planted hip-width, the other knee raised or the other leg extended toward the ceiling. Drive the hips up through the one side heel until the body is in a straight line, squeeze the one side glute hard at the top. Lower under control.

name: Glute Bridge — Single-Leg — Left Leg
setupNotes: Lie face up, left foot planted hip-width, right knee raised or right leg extended toward the ceiling. Drive the hips up through the left heel until the body is in a straight line, squeeze the left glute hard at the top. Lower under control.

name: Glute Bridge — Single-Leg — Right Leg
setupNotes: Lie face up, right foot planted hip-width, left knee raised or left leg extended toward the ceiling. Drive the hips up through the right heel until the body is in a straight line, squeeze the right glute hard at the top. Lower under control.

name: Glute Kickback Machine
setupNotes: Standing or kneeling at glute kickback machine. Pad behind one side ankle or knee. Push one side leg back and up, squeezing one side glute at top. Controlled return.

name: Glute Kickback Machine — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing or kneeling at glute kickback machine. Pad behind left ankle or knee. Push left leg back and up, squeezing left glute at top. Controlled return.

name: Glute Kickback Machine — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing or kneeling at glute kickback machine. Pad behind right ankle or knee. Push right leg back and up, squeezing right glute at top. Controlled return.

name: Glute Stretch — Figure 4
setupNotes: Lie face up with knees bent. Cross the one side ankle over the the other knee in a figure-4. Reach through and pull the the other side thigh toward the chest until a stretch is felt deep in the one side glute. Hold. Targets the one side piriformis.

name: Glute Stretch — Figure 4 — Left
setupNotes: Lie face up with knees bent. Cross the left ankle over the right knee in a figure-4. Reach through and pull the right thigh toward the chest until a stretch is felt deep in the left glute. Hold. Targets the left piriformis.

name: Glute Stretch — Figure 4 — Right
setupNotes: Lie face up with knees bent. Cross the right ankle over the left knee in a figure-4. Reach through and pull the left thigh toward the chest until a stretch is felt deep in the right glute. Hold. Targets the right piriformis.

name: Goblet Squat — B-Stance
setupNotes: Standing with one foot half a step behind (heel up, toe lightly anchored), hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height with both hands. Squat down driving mainly through the front leg. Unilateral emphasis with bilateral stability.

name: Goblet Squat — Elevated Heels
setupNotes: Standing on a small plate or wedge with heels elevated, hold one dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height with both hands. Squat down, elbows inside knees at bottom. Elevated heels bias load onto the quads.

name: Goblet Squat — Standard
setupNotes: Standing, hold one dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height with both hands. Feet shoulder-width. Squat down, elbows inside knees at bottom. Standard stance.

name: Hack Squat — Machine
setupNotes: Hack squat machine, shoulders under pads, back against pad. Feet shoulder-width on platform. Descend to parallel or below, press up.

name: Hack Squat Machine — Narrow Stance
setupNotes: Hack squat machine, shoulders under pads, back against pad. Feet narrow on platform, close together. Descend to parallel or below, press up — emphasizes outer quads.

name: Hack Squat Machine — Wide Stance
setupNotes: Hack squat machine, shoulders under pads, back against pad. Feet wide on platform, toes slightly out. Descend to parallel or below, press up — emphasizes inner thighs and glutes.

name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment or wedged in corner. Half-kneel facing the bar (one knee down, opposite foot forward). Grip the bar end with both hands at chin. Press diagonally upward to full extension — challenges core and shoulder stability through the offset stance.

name: Hamstring Stretch — Seated
setupNotes: Sit on the floor with the one side leg extended and the right foot tucked against the inner one side thigh. Hinge at the hips and reach over the one side leg, back flat. Hold and breathe. Targets the one side hamstring.

name: Hamstring Stretch — Seated — Left
setupNotes: Sit on the floor with the left leg extended and the right foot tucked against the inner left thigh. Hinge at the hips and reach over the left leg, back flat. Hold and breathe. Targets the left hamstring.

name: Hamstring Stretch — Seated — Right
setupNotes: Sit on the floor with the right leg extended and the left foot tucked against the inner right thigh. Hinge at the hips and reach over the right leg, back flat. Hold and breathe. Targets the right hamstring.

name: Hamstring Stretch — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, place the one side heel on a low bench or step with the leg straight. Hinge from the hips and lean forward over the one side leg, keeping the back flat. Hold. Targets the one side hamstring.

name: Hamstring Stretch — Standing — Left
setupNotes: Standing, place the left heel on a low bench or step with the leg straight. Hinge from the hips and lean forward over the left leg, keeping the back flat. Hold. Targets the left hamstring.

name: Hamstring Stretch — Standing — Right
setupNotes: Standing, place the right heel on a low bench or step with the leg straight. Hinge from the hips and lean forward over the right leg, keeping the back flat. Hold. Targets the right hamstring.

name: Hang Clean
setupNotes: Barbell at hip level in standing position. Dip-drive hips, explosively pull bar upward, catch on front delts in front rack. Start from hang, not floor.

name: Hanging Hamstring Stretch with Core Activation
setupNotes: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms, legs straight beneath you. Raise one leg to about parallel with the floor, hold to engage the core, then lower under control. Stretches hamstrings while activating the abs.

name: Hanging Hamstring Stretch with Core Activation — Left
setupNotes: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms, legs straight beneath you. Raise left leg to about parallel with the floor, hold to engage the core, then lower under control. Stretches hamstrings while activating the abs.
parentName: Hanging Hamstring Stretch with Core Activation

name: Hanging Hamstring Stretch with Core Activation — Right
setupNotes: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms, legs straight beneath you. Raise right leg to about parallel with the floor, hold to engage the core, then lower under control. Stretches hamstrings while activating the abs.
parentName: Hanging Hamstring Stretch with Core Activation

name: Hanging Knee Raise
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar with straight arms. Bring knees up to chest level. Controlled lower, avoid swinging. Flex abs, don't just swing legs.

name: Hanging Knee Raise — Side-to-Side
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar. Bring knees up and twist to one side, lower, repeat to other side. Oblique emphasis on the hanging knee raise.

name: Hanging Straight Leg Raise
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar, legs fully straight. Raise legs to horizontal or higher. Controlled lower. Avoid using momentum.

name: Hanging Windshield Wipers
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar, raise legs to horizontal. Sweep legs side to side like windshield wipers. Advanced rotational core exercise.

name: Heel Slide with Core Bracing
setupNotes: Same as standard heel slide. Actively brace core (draw navel in) before each slide. Focus on preventing any pelvic movement.

name: High Cable Curl
