setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulleys set high with D-handles. Stand centred, arms extended to sides. Curl handles toward ears — front double bicep position.

name: High Knee March
setupNotes: Standing, drive knees above hip level alternately. Pump arms opposite to legs. Moderate pace. Hip flexor activation and warm-up.

name: High Knee Tuck Jumps
setupNotes: Standing, jump explosively pulling both knees to chest at peak. Land softly with bent knees. Advanced plyometric.

name: High Knees
setupNotes: Standing, drive knees above hip height rapidly alternating legs. Pump arms. Fast pace. On the spot or moving slightly forward.

name: High Knees + Lateral Shuffle
setupNotes: Combine high knees with lateral shuffling steps. High knees for 4 steps, shuffle 4 steps sideways, repeat. Agility and cardio.

name: High Plank
setupNotes: Hands under shoulders, arms straight. Body straight, push floor away. Engage core, avoid sagging hips. Foundation position for many exercises.

name: High Plank Knee Drives
setupNotes: High plank position. Drive one knee toward chest quickly, return, repeat other knee. Mountain-climber style from plank. Controlled.

name: High Side Plank
setupNotes: Lie on side with bottom hand on floor directly under shoulder, arm fully straight. Stack or stagger feet. Press the floor away and lift hips into a straight line — top arm extended overhead or on hip. Targets obliques and shoulder stability.

name: High Side Plank — Left Side
setupNotes: Lie on side with bottom hand on floor directly under shoulder, arm fully straight. Stack or stagger feet. Press the floor away and lift hips into a straight line — top arm extended overhead or on hip. Targets obliques and shoulder stability.

name: High Side Plank — Right Side
setupNotes: Lie on side with bottom hand on floor directly under shoulder, arm fully straight. Stack or stagger feet. Press the floor away and lift hips into a straight line — top arm extended overhead or on hip. Targets obliques and shoulder stability.

name: Hip Abductor Machine
setupNotes: Seated hip abduction machine. Sit with outer thighs against pads. Push legs outward against resistance, controlled return. Targets glute medius.

name: Hip Adductor Machine
setupNotes: Seated hip adduction machine. Sit with inner thighs against pads. Squeeze legs together against resistance, controlled release. Inner thigh focus.

name: Hip Circles
setupNotes: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hands on hips. Rotate hips in large smooth circles — clockwise then counterclockwise. Keep upper body stable. Warms up hip joints and lower back.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch
setupNotes: Half-kneeling on the mat — one side knee down, right foot forward. Tuck the pelvis under and gently push the hips forward until a stretch is felt at the front of the one side hip. Stay tall through the torso. Hold. Stretches the one side hip flexor.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch — Left Hip
setupNotes: Half-kneeling on the mat — left knee down, right foot forward. Tuck the pelvis under and gently push the hips forward until a stretch is felt at the front of the left hip. Stay tall through the torso. Hold. Stretches the left hip flexor.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch — Right Hip
setupNotes: Half-kneeling on the mat — right knee down, left foot forward. Tuck the pelvis under and gently push the hips forward until a stretch is felt at the front of the right hip. Stay tall through the torso. Hold. Stretches the right hip flexor.

name: Hollow Body Hold
setupNotes: Lie face up, arms extended overhead, legs straight. Lift shoulders and legs off floor, lower back pressed into ground. Banana shape. Hold.

name: Hollow Rock
setupNotes: Full hollow body position — arms overhead, legs extended, both off floor. Rock forward and back maintaining rigid body shape.

name: Inchworm
setupNotes: Standing, fold forward touching floor. Walk hands out to plank position. Optional push-up. Walk feet to hands, stand up. Full body warm-up.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Incline bench (30-45 degrees) inside power rack. Bar at chest height, spotter recommended. Feet flat, shoulder blades retracted. Unrack, lower bar to upper chest — press up to lockout.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press — Narrow-Close Grip
setupNotes: Incline bench (30-45 degrees) inside power rack. Hands narrower than shoulders on the bar. Unrack, lower bar to upper chest with elbows tucked, press up to lockout — emphasises triceps and upper-chest fibres.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Incline bench with dumbbell rack nearby. Start with dumbbells on thighs, kick up to pressing position. Retract shoulder blades.

name: Incline Dumbbell Chest Fly
setupNotes: Incline bench with moderate dumbbells. Arms extended above chest, slight elbow bend. Lower in arc until stretch is felt.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on incline bench at ~45-60 degrees. Dumbbells hang at sides behind torso. Curl up, long head of biceps gets extra stretch.

name: Incline Hammer Curl
setupNotes: Seated on incline bench at ~45 degrees. Dumbbells at sides with neutral grip. Curl up — incline increases stretch on brachialis.

name: Incline Hammer Curl — Simultaneous
setupNotes: Seated on an incline bench set to roughly 45-60 degrees, a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral (palms-facing) hammer grip, arms hanging back behind the torso. Curl both arms up at the same time, thumbs pointing up, then lower under control — both arms move together every rep. The incline stretches the long head, biasing the biceps and brachialis.

name: Incline Machine Chest Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Incline chest press machine — adjust seat so handles align with upper chest. Grip overhand with palms down, back against pad, feet flat. Press handles forward and slightly up — targets upper chest and front delts.

name: Incline Pec Fly
setupNotes: Pec deck / fly machine set to an incline pad position (or use an incline-bench machine). Adjust seat so handles align with the upper chest, back firmly against pad, slight elbow bend. Bring handles together in a wide arc in front of the upper chest — emphasises clavicular (upper) chest fibres.

name: Incline Plank (Hands Elevated)
setupNotes: Hands on bench, box, or chair in plank position. Easier regression of floor plank. Good for beginners building core strength.

name: Incline Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands on bench, box, or sturdy elevated surface. Feet on floor. Straight body line. Easier regression — lower surface = harder. Full range of motion.

name: Incline Slow Tempo Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands elevated on bench or box, feet on floor, body in straight line. Lower chest toward bench for 3–4 seconds, pause 1 second at bottom, press up with control. Tempo work builds lower-chest endurance at an easier angle.

name: Incline Treadmill Walk
setupNotes: Treadmill at walking speed with incline raised (8-15%). Walk uphill. Do not hold handrails for full benefit. Glute and cardio emphasis.

name: Internal Rotation — Band
setupNotes: Anchor a band at elbow height to the one side. Stand with the one side toward the anchor, hold the band in the one hand with the elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees. Rotate the forearm inward across the body against the band. Trains the one side subscapularis.

name: Internal Rotation — Band (Left Arm)
setupNotes: Anchor a band at elbow height to the left. Stand with the left side toward the anchor, hold the band in the left hand with the elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees. Rotate the forearm inward across the body against the band. Trains the left subscapularis.

name: Internal Rotation — Band (Right Arm)
setupNotes: Anchor a band at elbow height to the right. Stand with the right side toward the anchor, hold the band in the right hand with the elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees. Rotate the forearm inward across the body against the band. Trains the right subscapularis.

name: Inverted Row — Feet Elevated
setupNotes: Same as standard inverted row but feet on bench or box. Increases difficulty by raising body angle closer to horizontal.

name: Inverted Row — Single-Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in rack. Grip bar with one hand, other arm at side or behind back. Row body up with one arm. Advanced unilateral.

name: Inverted Row — Single-Arm — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in rack. Grip bar with one hand, other arm at side or behind back. Row body up with one arm. Advanced unilateral.

name: Inverted Row — Single-Arm — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in rack. Grip bar with one hand, other arm at side or behind back. Row body up with one arm. Advanced unilateral.

name: Inverted Row — Standard — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Barbell in rack at waist height, or Smith machine bar. Hang underneath, body straight. Pull chest to bar. Use neutral grip position.

name: Inverted Row — Standard — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Barbell in rack at waist height, or Smith machine bar. Hang underneath, body straight. Pull chest to bar. Use overhand grip position.

name: Inverted Row — Standard — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Barbell in rack at waist height, or Smith machine bar. Hang underneath, body straight. Pull chest to bar. Use underhand grip position.

name: Inverted Row — Weighted
setupNotes: Standard inverted row setup. Place weight plate on chest or wear weighted vest for additional resistance.

name: Iso-Lateral Bench Press
setupNotes: Iso-lateral (independent-arm) plate-loaded chest press, flat setting. Adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest, feet flat, back against pad. Press one handle at a time or both together — independent arms force each side to do its own work. Targets chest with triceps assistance.

name: Iso-Lateral Incline Machine Chest Press
setupNotes: Iso-lateral (independent-arm) plate-loaded chest press, incline setting. Adjust seat so handles align with the upper chest, feet flat, back against pad. Press one handle at a time or both together to full extension — targets upper chest and front delts with no left/right cheating.

name: Iso-Lateral Low Row — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Iso-lateral (independent-arm) plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip handles with a neutral (palms-facing) grip. Pull handles to the ribs, elbows tracking close to body — squeeze shoulder blades. Targets mid-back and lats.

name: Iso-Lateral Low Row — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Iso-lateral (independent-arm) plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip handles with an overhand (pronated) grip. Pull handles to the ribs with elbows flared slightly — emphasises rear delts and upper back.

name: Iso-Lateral Low Row — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Iso-lateral (independent-arm) plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip handles with an underhand (supinated) grip. Pull handles to the lower ribs with elbows tucked close to body — biceps assist, emphasises lats.

name: Iso-Lateral Super Incline Press
setupNotes: Iso-lateral (independent-arm) plate-loaded shoulder-press machine, super-incline / near-vertical setting. Adjust seat so handles align with the shoulders, feet flat, back against pad. Press handles overhead one at a time or together — targets shoulders with upper-chest assistance.

name: Isometric Lateral Hold — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, raise light dumbbells to shoulder height laterally. Hold position for prescribed time. Maintain slight elbow bend.

name: Jump Squat
setupNotes: Feet shoulder-width, squat down, explode upward leaving the ground. Land softly in squat position. Repeat. Quad and glute power.

name: Jumping Jacks
setupNotes: Standing, feet together, arms at sides. Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead, jump back. Classic cardio warm-up. Continuous rhythm.

name: Jumping Lunge
setupNotes: Start in lunge position. Jump explosively, switch legs mid-air, land in opposite lunge. Continuous. Plyometric cardio and leg power.

name: Jumping / Plyo Lunge
setupNotes: Start in lunge position. Jump explosively, switch legs mid-air, land in opposite lunge. Continuous alternating. Cardio and power.

name: Kegel — Endurance Set
setupNotes: Seated or supine. Contract pelvic floor and hold for increasing durations (10, 15, 20 seconds). Full relaxation between holds.

name: Kegel — Quick Flicks
setupNotes: Same position. Rapidly contract and release pelvic floor muscles. 1-second hold, 1-second release. Builds fast-twitch pelvic floor response.

name: Kegel — Slow Hold
setupNotes: Seated or supine. Contract pelvic floor muscles (as if stopping urine flow). Hold for 5-10 seconds, fully relax for same duration. Repeat.

name: Kettlebell Clean
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on the floor between the feet. Hinge and grip with the one side hand, swing the bell back between the legs, then drive the hips and pull the bell up — rotate the wrist so it lands softly in the rack on the one side forearm and shoulder. Lower under control. Trains explosive hip drive and unilateral grip.

name: Kettlebell Clean — Left
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on the floor between the feet. Hinge and grip with the left hand, swing the bell back between the legs, then drive the hips and pull the bell up — rotate the wrist so it lands softly in the rack on the left forearm and shoulder. Lower under control. Trains explosive hip drive and unilateral grip.

name: Kettlebell Clean — Right
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on the floor between the feet. Hinge and grip with the right hand, swing the bell back between the legs, then drive the hips and pull the bell up — rotate the wrist so it lands softly in the rack on the right forearm and shoulder. Lower under control. Trains explosive hip drive and unilateral grip.

name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
setupNotes: Standing, kettlebell in each hand or single kettlebell in both. Same hip hinge pattern. Kettlebell shape allows natural hand position.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on floor. Explosive swing directly overhead in one motion. Lock out at top, controlled lower through swing. One arm at a time.

name: Kettlebell Snatch — Left Arm
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on the floor between the feet. Hinge and grip with the left hand, swing the bell back between the legs, then drive the hips and pull the bell straight overhead in one motion — punch through at the top so it lands softly on the back of the wrist with the arm locked. Controlled lower through the swing.

name: Kettlebell Snatch — Right Arm
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on the floor between the feet. Hinge and grip with the right hand, swing the bell back between the legs, then drive the hips and pull the bell straight overhead in one motion — punch through at the top so it lands softly on the back of the wrist with the arm locked. Controlled lower through the swing.

name: Kettlebell Swing
setupNotes: Standing, kettlebell on floor between feet. Hike KB back between legs, drive hips forward explosively to swing KB to chest/eye height. Hinge, not squat.

name: Knee Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands on floor shoulder-width, knees on mat. Straight line from head to knees. Lower chest to floor, press up. Beginner progression.

name: Kneeling Ab Wheel Rollout
setupNotes: Kneeling, grip ab wheel. Roll forward extending body toward floor, pull back using core. Prevent lower back sag.

name: Kneeling Cable Crunch
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope attachment. Kneel facing machine, rope behind head. Crunch forward, curling torso, elbows toward knees. Control eccentric.

name: Kneeling Cable Face Pull
setupNotes: Cable at upper-chest height, rope attachment. Pull toward face, hands ending beside ears. Elbows high, squeeze rear delts. Kneeling.

name: Kneeling Cable Woodchop
setupNotes: Cable at high or low position. Kneel sideways, chop diagonally across body. Kneeling removes leg drive, isolates obliques and trunk rotation.

name: Kneeling Cable Woodchop — Left
setupNotes: Cable at high pulley with rope or D-handle. Half-kneel with the right knee down, right side toward the stack, both hands on the handle overhead-right. Pull diagonally across and down to the low-left hip, rotating through the torso. Kneeling removes leg drive — isolates obliques.

name: Kneeling Cable Woodchop — Right
setupNotes: Cable at high pulley with rope or D-handle. Half-kneel with the left knee down, left side toward the stack, both hands on the handle overhead-left. Pull diagonally across and down to the low-right hip, rotating through the torso. Kneeling removes leg drive — isolates obliques.

name: Kneeling Double-Arm Landmine Chest Press
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner. Tall-kneel facing the bar with both knees on the floor, both hands cupped around the end of the bar at the chest. Press forward and up in a roughly horizontal arc to full extension, then lower under control — the kneeling base removes leg drive and raises core demand while emphasising the chest (pecs) and front delts.

name: Kneeling Double-Arm Landmine Shoulder Press
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner. Tall-kneel facing the bar with both knees on the floor, both hands cupped around the end of the bar at the chest. Press more vertically toward overhead to full extension, then lower under control — the kneeling base removes leg drive and stacks core demand while targeting the shoulders (delts).

name: Kneeling Landmine Press
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment or wedged in corner. Half-kneel facing the bar, grip end of bar at chest with both hands. Press up and forward in an arc to full extension — targets upper chest and front delts while removing lower-body drive.

name: Kneeling Single-Arm Landmine Press — Chest
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner, gripping the end of the bar with one hand. Tall-kneel facing the bar with both knees on the mat, the working arm racked at shoulder height, free hand on the thigh. Press the bar forward and up in a roughly horizontal arc to full extension, then lower under control. Loads the chest and front delt with strong unilateral core and anti-rotation demand.

name: Kneeling Single-Arm Landmine Press — Chest — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner, gripping the end of the bar with the left hand. Tall-kneel facing the bar with both knees on the mat, left arm racked at shoulder height, right hand resting on the thigh. Press the bar forward and up in a roughly horizontal arc to full extension, then lower under control. Loads the left chest and front delt with strong core and anti-rotation demand.

name: Kneeling Single-Arm Landmine Press — Chest — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner, gripping the end of the bar with the right hand. Tall-kneel facing the bar with both knees on the mat, right arm racked at shoulder height, left hand resting on the thigh. Press the bar forward and up in a roughly horizontal arc to full extension, then lower under control. Loads the right chest and front delt with strong core and anti-rotation demand.

name: Kneeling Single-Arm Landmine Press — Shoulder
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner, gripping the end of the bar with one hand. Tall-kneel facing the bar with both knees on the mat, the working arm racked at shoulder height, free hand on the thigh. Press the bar more vertically overhead to full extension, then lower under control. Targets the shoulders with strong unilateral core and anti-rotation demand.

name: Kneeling Single-Arm Landmine Press — Shoulder — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner, gripping the end of the bar with the left hand. Tall-kneel facing the bar with both knees on the mat, left arm racked at shoulder height, right hand resting on the thigh. Press the bar more vertically overhead to full extension, then lower under control. Targets the left shoulder with strong core and anti-rotation demand.

name: Kneeling Single-Arm Landmine Press — Shoulder — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner, gripping the end of the bar with the right hand. Tall-kneel facing the bar with both knees on the mat, right arm racked at shoulder height, left hand resting on the thigh. Press the bar more vertically overhead to full extension, then lower under control. Targets the right shoulder with strong core and anti-rotation demand.

name: Kroc Row
setupNotes: One hand on bench or rack for support. Heavy dumbbell, slight torso rotation allowed. High-rep, explosive rowing for back thickness.

name: Kroc Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: One hand on bench or rack for support. Heavy dumbbell, slight torso rotation allowed. High-rep, explosive rowing for back thickness.

name: Kroc Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: One hand on bench or rack for support. Heavy dumbbell, slight torso rotation allowed. High-rep, explosive rowing for back thickness.

name: L-Sit Hang
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar. Raise straight legs to horizontal (L position) and hold. Timed isometric. Core and hip flexor endurance.

name: L-Sit Pull-Up
setupNotes: Hang from a pull-up bar with shoulder-width overhand grip. Raise legs to a 90-degree L-sit and hold the position throughout. Pull chest to bar keeping legs locked out — lower with control. Advanced — combines isometric core hold with vertical pull.

name: Lacrosse Ball — Piriformis
setupNotes: Sit on a lacrosse ball positioned under the one side glute/piriformis, one side ankle crossed over the the other knee in a figure-4. Roll gently or hold pressure on the tender spot. Releases the one side piriformis.

name: Lacrosse Ball — Piriformis — Left
setupNotes: Sit on a lacrosse ball positioned under the left glute/piriformis, left ankle crossed over the right knee in a figure-4. Roll gently or hold pressure on the tender spot. Releases the left piriformis.

name: Lacrosse Ball — Piriformis — Right
setupNotes: Sit on a lacrosse ball positioned under the right glute/piriformis, right ankle crossed over the left knee in a figure-4. Roll gently or hold pressure on the tender spot. Releases the right piriformis.

name: Lacrosse Ball — Shoulder/Rear Delt
setupNotes: Stand with a lacrosse ball pinned between the one side upper back/rear delt and a wall. Lean into the ball to apply pressure and roll in small circles to find tight spots. Releases the one side rear delt and upper trap.

name: Lacrosse Ball — Shoulder/Rear Delt — Left
setupNotes: Stand with a lacrosse ball pinned between the left upper back/rear delt and a wall. Lean into the ball to apply pressure and roll in small circles to find tight spots. Releases the left rear delt and upper trap.

name: Lacrosse Ball — Shoulder/Rear Delt — Right
setupNotes: Stand with a lacrosse ball pinned between the right upper back/rear delt and a wall. Lean into the ball to apply pressure and roll in small circles to find tight spots. Releases the right rear delt and upper trap.

name: Landmine Rotation
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Hold end of bar with both hands at chest level. Rotate torso, moving bar in arc from side to side. Controlled.

name: Lat Pulldown — Neutral/Close Grip
setupNotes: V-handle or close-grip attachment on lat pulldown. Sit upright, pull to chest, elbows close to body. Squeeze at bottom.

name: Lat Pulldown — Reverse Grip — Close Grip
setupNotes: Straight bar on lat pulldown, underhand (supinated) grip, hands close together. Pull bar to upper chest — lean back slightly, squeeze lats at bottom.

name: Lat Pulldown — Reverse Grip — Standard Grip
setupNotes: Straight bar on lat pulldown, underhand (supinated) grip, hands shoulder-width apart. Pull bar to upper chest — lean back slightly, squeeze lats at bottom.

name: Lat Pulldown — Wide Grip
setupNotes: Cable lat pulldown machine, wide bar attached. Sit with thighs under pad, grip bar wider than shoulder-width. Pull to upper chest, squeeze lats.

name: Lateral Band Walk
setupNotes: Mini resistance band around ankles or just above knees. Quarter squat athletic stance. Step sideways maintaining band tension. Continuous side steps.

name: Lateral Raise — Cable
setupNotes: Single low cable pulley, D-handle. Stand sideways to machine. Raise arm out to side to shoulder height. Constant cable tension.

name: Lateral Raise — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, light dumbbells at sides. Raise arms out to sides until parallel with floor, slight bend in elbows. Controlled lowering.

name: Lateral Squat
setupNotes: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes forward. Shift the weight to the one side, bending the one knee into a deep side squat while the the other leg stays straight. Push through the one side heel to return to centre. Loads the one side adductor and glute.

name: Lateral Squat — Left Leg
setupNotes: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes forward. Shift the weight to the left, bending the left knee into a deep side squat while the right leg stays straight. Push through the left heel to return to centre. Loads the left adductor and glute.

name: Lateral Squat — Right Leg
setupNotes: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes forward. Shift the weight to the right, bending the right knee into a deep side squat while the left leg stays straight. Push through the right heel to return to centre. Loads the right adductor and glute.

name: Lateral Step-Up
setupNotes: Stand with bench/box on your one side side. Step up sideways with one side foot onto box, drive through one side glute to stand fully, controlled step down. All reps on one side side.

name: Lateral Step-Up — Left Leg
setupNotes: Stand with bench/box on your left side. Step up sideways with left foot onto box, drive through left glute to stand fully, controlled step down. All reps on left side.

name: Lateral Step-Up — Right Leg
setupNotes: Stand with bench/box on your right side. Step up sideways with right foot onto box, drive through right glute to stand fully, controlled step down. All reps on right side.

name: Leaning Lateral Raise
setupNotes: Standing beside a rack post or cable column, hold the post with the right hand and lean the body away to the one side. Light dumbbell in the each hand, arm hanging. Raise the each arm out to the side to shoulder height — leaning increases the range of motion at the bottom and constant tension on the medial delt.

name: Leaning Lateral Raise — Left
setupNotes: Standing beside a rack post or cable column, hold the post with the right hand and lean the body away to the left. Light dumbbell in the left hand, arm hanging. Raise the left arm out to the side to shoulder height — leaning increases the range of motion at the bottom and constant tension on the medial delt.

name: Leaning Lateral Raise — Right
setupNotes: Standing beside a rack post or cable column, hold the post with the left hand and lean the body away to the right. Light dumbbell in the right hand, arm hanging. Raise the right arm out to the side to shoulder height — leaning increases the range of motion at the bottom and constant tension on the medial delt.

name: Leg Extension — Seated (Double-Leg)
setupNotes: Seated leg extension machine. Shin pad on lower shins. Extend legs to full lockout, squeeze quads at top, controlled lower.

name: Leg Extension — Single-Leg
setupNotes: Seated leg extension machine, shin pad on lower one side shin, right leg relaxed to the side. Extend the one side leg to full lockout, squeeze the quad, control the lower. Lighter load — exposes and corrects left-side imbalances.

name: Leg Extension — Single-Leg — Left Leg
setupNotes: Seated leg extension machine, shin pad on lower left shin, right leg relaxed to the side. Extend the left leg to full lockout, squeeze the quad, control the lower. Lighter load — exposes and corrects left-side imbalances.

name: Leg Extension — Single-Leg — Right Leg
setupNotes: Seated leg extension machine, shin pad on lower right shin, left leg relaxed to the side. Extend the right leg to full lockout, squeeze the quad, control the lower. Lighter load — exposes and corrects right-side imbalances.

name: Leg Press — High Foot Placement
setupNotes: Leg press machine, feet placed high on platform. Greater hamstring and glute emphasis. Lower until knees at ~90 degrees, press up.

name: Leg Press — Low Foot Placement
setupNotes: Leg press machine, feet placed low on platform. Greater quad emphasis — deeper knee flexion. Watch knee tracking over toes.

name: Leg Press — Standard — Hip-Width
setupNotes: Leg press machine. Sit with back against pad, feet hip-width on platform. Release safety catches, lower weight until knees at ~90 degrees, press up.

name: Leg Press — Standard — Hip-Width — Left Leg
setupNotes: Leg press machine, back against pad, left foot centred on platform (right foot off). Lower weight until knee reaches ~90 degrees, press up through the heel. Lighter load than bilateral — exposes left-side imbalances.

name: Leg Press — Standard — Hip-Width — Right Leg
setupNotes: Leg press machine, back against pad, right foot centred on platform (left foot off). Lower weight until knee reaches ~90 degrees, press up through the heel. Lighter load than bilateral — exposes right-side imbalances.

name: Leg Press — Standard — Narrow
setupNotes: Leg press machine. Sit with back against pad, feet narrow on platform. Release safety catches, lower weight until knees at ~90 degrees, press up.

name: Leg Press — Standard — Wide
setupNotes: Leg press machine. Sit with back against pad, feet wide on platform. Release safety catches, lower weight until knees at ~90 degrees, press up.

name: Leg Press — Sumo Hip-Width
setupNotes: Leg press machine. Sit with back against pad, feet wider than shoulder-width in sumo stance, toes turned out. Release safety catches, lower weight until knees at ~90 degrees, press up — emphasizes inner thighs and glutes.

name: Leg Swings — Front to Back
setupNotes: Stand with the right side near a wall, right hand on the wall for balance. Swing the one side leg forward and backward in a controlled pendulum, gradually increasing range. Warms up the one side hip flexors and hamstrings.

name: Leg Swings — Front to Back (Left Leg)
setupNotes: Stand with the right side near a wall, right hand on the wall for balance. Swing the left leg forward and backward in a controlled pendulum, gradually increasing range. Warms up the left hip flexors and hamstrings.
parentName: Leg Swings — Front to Back (Left Leg)

name: Leg Swings — Front to Back (Right Leg)
setupNotes: Stand with the left side near a wall, left hand on the wall for balance. Swing the right leg forward and backward in a controlled pendulum, gradually increasing range. Warms up the right hip flexors and hamstrings.
parentName: Leg Swings — Front to Back (Right Leg)

name: Leg Swings — Side to Side
setupNotes: Face a wall, both hands on it for support, weight on the right leg. Swing the one side leg across the body and out to the side in a controlled pendulum. Warms up the one side adductors and abductors.

name: Leg Swings — Side to Side (Left Leg)
setupNotes: Face a wall, both hands on it for support, weight on the right leg. Swing the left leg across the body and out to the side in a controlled pendulum. Warms up the left adductors and abductors.
parentName: Leg Swings — Side to Side (Left Leg)

name: Leg Swings — Side to Side (Right Leg)
setupNotes: Face a wall, both hands on it for support, weight on the left leg. Swing the right leg across the body and out to the side in a controlled pendulum. Warms up the right adductors and abductors.
parentName: Leg Swings — Side to Side (Right Leg)

name: Lu Raise
setupNotes: Standing with light dumbbells. Front raise to shoulder height, then continue into lateral raise position without lowering. Smooth arc motion.

name: Lying Leg Raise — Alternating
setupNotes: Same position as standard. Lift one leg at a time, alternating. Easier progression. Keep lower back pressed into floor.

name: Lying Leg Raise — Standard
setupNotes: Lie face up, hands under lower back or at sides. Legs straight, lift from floor to vertical. Lower controlled without arching back.

name: Lying Leg Raise with Hold
setupNotes: Raise both legs to ~6 inches off floor. Hold for prescribed time. Lower back pressed into floor. Isometric lower ab hold.

name: Lying (Prone) Leg Curl
setupNotes: Lying face down on leg curl machine. Pad on lower calves/ankles. Curl heels toward glutes, squeeze hamstrings at top, controlled lower.

name: Machine-Assisted Pull-Up
setupNotes: Assisted pull-up / dip machine. Kneel or stand on pad, select counterweight. Grip bar overhead, pull chin above bar.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
setupNotes: Dedicated hip thrust / glute drive machine. Sit in machine, back against pad, feet on platform. Drive hips forward to full extension. Squeeze glutes.

name: Machine Shoulder Press — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Adjust seat so handles start at ear level. Back against pad, feet flat. Press to full extension. Use neutral grip position.

name: Machine Shoulder Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Adjust seat so handles start at ear level. Back against pad, feet flat. Press to full extension. Use overhand grip position.

name: Machine Shoulder Press — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Adjust seat so handles start at ear level. Back against pad, feet flat. Press to full extension. Use underhand grip position.

name: March in Place — Standard
setupNotes: Standing, alternate lifting knees to hip height. Pump arms naturally opposite to legs. Controlled pace for warm-up or light cardio.

name: Meadows Row
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Stand perpendicular to the bar in a staggered stance with right foot forward. Overhand grip on the end of the bar with the one side hand — row to one side hip with slight torso rotation. Targets the lats and upper back.

name: Meadows Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Stand perpendicular to the bar in a staggered stance with right foot forward. Overhand grip on the end of the bar with the left hand — row to left hip with slight torso rotation. Targets the lats and upper back.

name: Meadows Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Stand perpendicular to the bar in a staggered stance with left foot forward. Overhand grip on the end of the bar with the right hand — row to right hip with slight torso rotation. Targets the lats and upper back.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
setupNotes: Standing, medicine ball (slam ball) overhead. Slam ball into floor with maximum force using whole body. Pick up and repeat. Use dead bounce slam ball.

name: Mountain Climber — Cross-Body
setupNotes: High plank position. Drive knee toward opposite elbow. Alternate sides. Rotational element adds oblique engagement to standard climber.

name: Mountain Climber — Standard
setupNotes: High plank position. Drive one knee toward chest quickly, switch, repeat. Fast alternating like running in place horizontally.

name: Mountain Climbers — Fast
setupNotes: High plank position. Sprint knees toward chest alternately as fast as possible. Maintain plank integrity. HIIT cardio from plank.

name: Neck Side Stretch
setupNotes: Standing or seated tall, gently tilt the the other side ear toward the the other side shoulder, keeping the one side shoulder relaxed and pressed down. Optionally use the the other hand for light additional pressure. Hold. Stretches the one side of the neck.

name: Neck Side Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Standing or seated tall, gently tilt the right ear toward the right shoulder, keeping the left shoulder relaxed and pressed down. Optionally use the right hand for light additional pressure. Hold. Stretches the left side of the neck.

name: Neck Side Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Standing or seated tall, gently tilt the left ear toward the left shoulder, keeping the right shoulder relaxed and pressed down. Optionally use the left hand for light additional pressure. Hold. Stretches the right side of the neck.

name: Negative (Eccentric) Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar. Jump or step to top position (chin over bar). Lower body as slowly as possible (5-10 seconds). Repeat.

name: Negative-Only Push-Up
setupNotes: Standard push-up position. Lower body as slowly as possible (5-8 seconds) to floor. Reset to top position and repeat. Eccentric strength.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
setupNotes: Kneeling on mat, ankles anchored (partner holds, GHD pad, or loaded barbell). Lower body forward under control, catch yourself and push back up. Eccentric hamstring.

name: Oblique Cable Crunch
setupNotes: High cable pulley, D-handle or rope. Stand sideways to machine. Crunch laterally, pulling toward hip on cable side. Side-bend motion.

name: Oblique Cable Crunch — Left
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope or D-handle. Kneel facing the machine, rope behind the head. Crunch the torso down and rotate toward the left hip, bringing the right elbow toward the left knee. Controlled return — emphasises the right obliques.

name: Oblique Cable Crunch — Right
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope or D-handle. Kneel facing the machine, rope behind the head. Crunch the torso down and rotate toward the right hip, bringing the left elbow toward the right knee. Controlled return — emphasises the left obliques.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
setupNotes: Right hand and right knee on flat bench, one side foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell in one side hand hanging below shoulder — row to one side hip, elbow close to body. Squeeze the lat at the top.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: Right hand and right knee on flat bench, left foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell in left hand hanging below shoulder — row to left hip, elbow close to body. Squeeze the lat at the top.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: Left hand and left knee on flat bench, right foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell in right hand hanging below shoulder — row to right hip, elbow close to body. Squeeze the lat at the top.

name: Overhead Arm Hold
setupNotes: Standing, hold light dumbbells or no weight with arms straight overhead. Hold for time. Shoulder endurance and thoracic mobility.

name: Overhead Arm Reach Hold
setupNotes: Standing, extend both arms straight overhead. Hold for prescribed time. Challenges shoulder endurance and thoracic mobility.

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
setupNotes: Raise the one side arm overhead and bend the elbow so the one side hand drops behind the head. Use the right hand to gently press the one side elbow back and down. Hold. Stretches the one side triceps and lat.

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Raise the left arm overhead and bend the elbow so the left hand drops behind the head. Use the right hand to gently press the left elbow back and down. Hold. Stretches the left triceps and lat.

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Raise the right arm overhead and bend the elbow so the right hand drops behind the head. Use the left hand to gently press the right elbow back and down. Hold. Stretches the right triceps and lat.

name: Overhead Walking Lunge
setupNotes: Dumbbells or barbell held overhead with arms locked out. Walk forward in lunges. Extreme core and shoulder stability demand.

name: Pallof Press — Half-Kneeling with Rotation
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Half-kneel with the right knee down (closest to the stack), one foot forward, both hands on the handle at the chest. Press the handle out to full extension, then slowly rotate the torso away from the stack to one side and return. Combines anti-rotation with controlled rotation in a low-base position.

name: Pallof Press — Half-Kneeling with Rotation — Left Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Half-kneel with the right knee down (closest to the stack), left foot forward, both hands on the handle at the chest. Press the handle out to full extension, then slowly rotate the torso away from the stack to the left and return. Combines anti-rotation with controlled rotation in a low-base position.

name: Pallof Press — Half-Kneeling with Rotation — Right Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Half-kneel with the left knee down (closest to the stack), right foot forward, both hands on the handle at the chest. Press the handle out to full extension, then slowly rotate the torso away from the stack to the right and return. Combines anti-rotation with controlled rotation in a low-base position.

name: Pallof Press — Standard
setupNotes: Cable at chest height with a D-handle. Stand with the right side toward the stack, hold the handle with both hands at the chest. Press the arms straight forward and resist the cable pulling you into rotation toward the right. Return to chest. Anti-rotation core work.

name: Pallof Press — Standard — Left Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height with a D-handle. Stand with the right side toward the stack, hold the handle with both hands at the chest. Press the arms straight forward and resist the cable pulling you into rotation toward the right. Return to chest. Anti-rotation core work.

name: Pallof Press — Standard — Right Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height with a D-handle. Stand with the left side toward the stack, hold the handle with both hands at the chest. Press the arms straight forward and resist the cable pulling you into rotation toward the left. Return to chest. Anti-rotation core work.

name: Pallof Press — With Rotation
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Stand with the right side toward the stack, press the handle out from the chest. From the pressed position slowly rotate the torso away from the stack to the left, then return under control. Combines anti-rotation with controlled rotation.

name: Pallof Press — With Rotation — Left Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Stand with the right side toward the stack, press the handle out from the chest. From the pressed position slowly rotate the torso away from the stack to the left, then return under control. Combines anti-rotation with controlled rotation.

name: Pallof Press — With Rotation — Right Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Stand with the left side toward the stack, press the handle out from the chest. From the pressed position slowly rotate the torso away from the stack to the right, then return under control. Combines anti-rotation with controlled rotation.

name: Parallel Bar Dip — Triceps Focus
setupNotes: Parallel dip bars. Upright torso (not leaning forward), elbows close to body and pointing back. Lower until elbows at 90 degrees, press up.

name: Pec Deck Machine
setupNotes: Adjust seat height so arms are at chest level. Pads or handles at shoulder width. Back firmly against pad, slight elbow bend.

name: Pelvic-Balloon Breathing
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees bent. Visualise pelvic floor as balloon inflating on inhale (relaxes down) and deflating on exhale (draws up). Coordinate breath.

name: Pelvic Tilts
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees bent, feet flat. Gently tilt pelvis — flatten lower back against floor (posterior tilt), then release to neutral. Gentle rocking motion.

name: Pendlay Row
setupNotes: Barbell on floor. Hinge at hips until torso is parallel to floor. Explosive row from dead stop on each rep. Bar returns to floor between reps.

name: Pendulum Squat
setupNotes: Pendulum squat machine. Shoulders under pads, feet on platform. Machine pivots on arc. Squat deep with constant tension. Very quad-dominant.

name: Pigeon Stretch
setupNotes: From hands and knees, slide the one knee forward behind the one side wrist with the shin angled across the body. Extend the the other leg straight back. Lower the torso over the one side shin. Hold and breathe. Deep stretch of the one side external rotators and glute.

name: Pigeon Stretch — Left
setupNotes: From hands and knees, slide the left knee forward behind the left wrist with the shin angled across the body. Extend the right leg straight back. Lower the torso over the left shin. Hold and breathe. Deep stretch of the left external rotators and glute.

name: Pigeon Stretch — Right
setupNotes: From hands and knees, slide the right knee forward behind the right wrist with the shin angled across the body. Extend the left leg straight back. Lower the torso over the right shin. Hold and breathe. Deep stretch of the right external rotators and glute.

name: Pike Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands on floor, hips piked high (inverted V shape). Feet can be on floor or elevated on bench for extra difficulty. Lower head toward floor, press up. Shoulder emphasis.

name: Plank Hip Dips
setupNotes: Forearm plank position. Rotate hips to lower one side toward floor, then other side. Alternating. Controlled rotation, oblique emphasis.

name: Plank Jacks
setupNotes: High or forearm plank position. Jump feet apart and together (like horizontal jumping jacks). Maintain rigid core. Cardio + core.

name: Plank Shoulder Taps
setupNotes: High plank position, feet slightly wider than hip-width. Tap right hand to left shoulder, left hand to right shoulder. Minimise hip sway.

name: Plank to Push-Up
setupNotes: Start in forearm plank. Push up to high plank one arm at a time, then lower back to forearms. Alternate lead arm each rep.

name: Plank Up-Down — Standard
setupNotes: Start in forearm plank. Push up to high plank one arm at a time, then lower back to forearms. Alternate lead arm each rep.

name: Plate Pinch Hold
setupNotes: Standing, pinch two smooth weight plates together with fingers on one side and thumb on other. Hold for time. Builds pinch grip strength.

name: Power Clean
setupNotes: Barbell on floor, grip just outside knees. First pull to knees, explosive second pull (hips), catch bar on front delts in front rack. Reset to floor.

name: Prisoner Squat
setupNotes: Standing, hands behind head, elbows wide. Perform bodyweight squat. Hands behind head forces upright torso and challenges mobility.

name: Push Press
setupNotes: Bar in front rack on shoulders. Dip knees slightly, drive explosively through legs to press bar overhead to lockout. More weight than strict press.

name: Push-Up (Standard)
setupNotes: Hands shoulder-width on floor, body in straight line from head to heels. Full range — chest to floor, arms fully extended at top.

name: Push-Up to Renegade Row
setupNotes: Push-up position with hands on hex dumbbells. Perform push-up, then row one dumbbell to hip, alternate. Wide foot stance for stability.

name: Rack Pull — Above Knee
setupNotes: Barbell on power rack pins set above knee height. Conventional deadlift grip. Stand up to lockout, squeeze traps and upper back at top.

name: Rear Delt Fly — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Bent over at hips ~45 degrees, dumbbells hanging below chest. Raise arms out to sides, leading with elbows. Light weight, controlled.

name: Rear Delt Fly — Dumbbell — Strong
setupNotes: Bent over at hips ~45 degrees, slight knee bend, flat back, dumbbells hanging below chest with neutral grip. Raise arms wide leading with the elbows until upper arms are parallel to floor — heavier load than standard rear delt fly, slight body english allowed. Controlled lower, squeeze the rear delts and mid-traps.

name: Rear Delt Fly — Machine
setupNotes: Sit facing pad on pec deck / rear delt machine. Grip handles with arms extended. Pull handles back in arc, squeezing rear delts.

name: Renegade Row
setupNotes: Push-up position with hands on dumbbells (hex dumbbells preferred). Row one dumbbell to hip while stabilising on the other. Alternate sides.

name: Resistance Band Scapular Retraction
setupNotes: Anchor band at chest height. Hold with straight arms. Pull shoulder blades together without bending elbows. Release controlled.

name: Reverse Barbell Curl
setupNotes: Standing, overhand (pronated) grip on barbell at shoulder-width. Curl up keeping palms down. Targets brachioradialis and forearm extensors.

name: Reverse Barbell Curl — EZ Bar
setupNotes: Standing, EZ-curl bar held with overhand (pronated) grip at shoulder-width. Elbows tucked at sides. Curl up keeping wrists straight, forearms doing the work. Slight knuckles-up cant of the EZ bar is gentler on wrists than a straight bar — emphasises brachialis and forearm extensors.

name: Reverse Cable Curl
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, straight bar. Overhand (pronated) grip. Curl up keeping palms down. Cable provides constant tension on forearm extensors.

name: Reverse Cable Curl — Narrow Closed Grip
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, straight bar. Overhand (pronated) closed grip, hands narrower than shoulder-width. Curl the bar up keeping palms down and elbows pinned to ribs. Narrow pronated grip biases the brachioradialis and forearm extensors.

name: Reverse Clamshell
setupNotes: Lie on the the other side, knees bent and stacked. Keep the knees pressed together and lift the one side (top) foot upward, rotating from the one hip. Lower under control. Trains internal rotation of the one hip.

name: Reverse Clamshell — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the right side, knees bent and stacked. Keep the knees pressed together and lift the left (top) foot upward, rotating from the left hip. Lower under control. Trains internal rotation of the left hip.

name: Reverse Clamshell — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the left side, knees bent and stacked. Keep the knees pressed together and lift the right (top) foot upward, rotating from the right hip. Lower under control. Trains internal rotation of the right hip.

name: Reverse Crunch
setupNotes: Lie on back, hands at sides for support. Bring knees toward chest by curling hips off the floor — lift the lower spine, not just legs. Controlled lower. Targets the lower abs.

name: Reverse Hyper
setupNotes: Reverse hyper machine. Lie face down, hips at edge of pad, grip handles. Extend legs behind and upward using glutes/hamstrings. Controlled swing.

name: Reverse Lunge — Barbell
setupNotes: Standing tall with a barbell on the upper back, feet hip-width. Step the one side foot back into a long lunge, lowering until both knees reach ~90 degrees and the one side back knee hovers above the floor. Drive through the right front heel to return to standing. Loads the right front quad and glute under barbell load.

name: Reverse Lunge — Barbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall with a barbell on the upper back, feet hip-width. Step the left foot back into a long lunge, lowering until both knees reach ~90 degrees and the left back knee hovers above the floor. Drive through the right front heel to return to standing. Loads the right front quad and glute under barbell load.

name: Reverse Lunge — Barbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall with a barbell on the upper back, feet hip-width. Step the right foot back into a long lunge, lowering until both knees reach ~90 degrees and the right back knee hovers above the floor. Drive through the left front heel to return to standing. Loads the left front quad and glute under barbell load.

name: Reverse Lunge — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Standing tall, hands on hips. Step the one foot back into a long lunge, lowering until both knees reach ~90 degrees and the one side back knee hovers above the floor. Drive through the the other side front heel to return to standing. Loads the the other side front quad and glute.

name: Reverse Lunge — Bodyweight — Left
setupNotes: Standing tall, hands on hips. Step the left foot back into a long lunge, lowering until both knees reach ~90 degrees and the left back knee hovers above the floor. Drive through the right front heel to return to standing. Loads the right front quad and glute.

name: Reverse Lunge — Bodyweight — Right
setupNotes: Standing tall, hands on hips. Step the right foot back into a long lunge, lowering until both knees reach ~90 degrees and the right back knee hovers above the floor. Drive through the left front heel to return to standing. Loads the left front quad and glute.

name: Reverse Lunge — Dumbbell/Barbell
setupNotes: Standing with dumbbells at sides or barbell on back. Step backward into lunge, lower until front thigh is parallel. Return to start.

name: Reverse Lunge — Dumbbell/Barbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall with dumbbells at sides or barbell on back, feet hip-width. Step the left foot back into a long lunge until both knees reach ~90 degrees, left back knee hovering above the floor. Drive through the right front heel to return to standing. Loads the right front quad and glute.

name: Reverse Lunge — Dumbbell/Barbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall with dumbbells at sides or barbell on back, feet hip-width. Step the right foot back into a long lunge until both knees reach ~90 degrees, right back knee hovering above the floor. Drive through the left front heel to return to standing. Loads the left front quad and glute.

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
setupNotes: Kneeling upright on mat (padding under knees). Lean backward slowly keeping hips extended. Feel quad stretch, return to upright. Quad eccentric.

name: Reverse Plank
setupNotes: Sit on floor, hands behind hips, fingers forward. Lift hips until body is straight from shoulders to heels. Squeeze glutes, hold. Triceps and core.

name: Reverse Plank Push-Up (Dip-Style)
setupNotes: Reverse plank position. Bend elbows to lower body, press back up. Like a bench dip but from floor with legs extended straight.

name: Reverse Plank with Leg Lifts
setupNotes: Standard reverse plank position. Alternate lifting one leg at a time, keeping it straight. Adds glute and core demand to hold.

name: Reverse Snow Angels — Standard
setupNotes: Lie prone on mat, arms extended overhead. Sweep arms in arc from overhead to hips and back, keeping arms off the ground throughout.

name: Reverse Snow Angels — Weighted
setupNotes: Same prone position. Hold very light dumbbells (1-2 kg) in each hand. Slow arc from overhead to hips and back.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
setupNotes: Seated, forearms on thighs or preacher bench, palms down. Barbell in hands. Extend wrists upward, controlled lower. Light weight, high reps.

name: Romanian Deadlift — Barbell
setupNotes: Standing, barbell at hip level. Slight knee bend, hinge at hips pushing them back, lower bar along thighs to mid-shin. Flat back, squeeze glutes to return.

name: Romanian Deadlift — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbell in each hand at front of thighs. Same hip hinge as barbell version. Allows more natural arm path.

name: Romanian Deadlift — Trap Bar
setupNotes: Standing inside trap bar. Slight knee bend, hinge at hips, lower bar along sides. Neutral grip is easier on lower back.

name: Rotational Push-Up
setupNotes: High plank position, body in a straight line. Perform a push-up, then at the top rotate the body open to the one side into a side plank — one side arm extended toward the ceiling, weight on the right hand. Return to plank and reset. Builds rotational core and shoulder stability.

name: Rotational Push-Up — Left
setupNotes: High plank position, body in a straight line. Perform a push-up, then at the top rotate the body open to the left into a side plank — left arm extended toward the ceiling, weight on the right hand. Return to plank and reset. Builds rotational core and shoulder stability.

name: Rotational Push-Up — Right
setupNotes: High plank position, body in a straight line. Perform a push-up, then at the top rotate the body open to the right into a side plank — right arm extended toward the ceiling, weight on the left hand. Return to plank and reset. Builds rotational core and shoulder stability.

name: Rower — Sprint Intervals
setupNotes: Rowing machine. Alternate between max-effort sprints (20-30 seconds) and easy recovery rowing (60-90 seconds). Damper setting at 4-6.

name: Rower — Steady
setupNotes: Rowing machine. Strap feet in, grip handle. Drive with legs first, then lean back, then pull arms. Reverse sequence on return. Steady pace.

name: Russian Twist — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Sit on floor, lean back ~45 degrees, feet off ground or anchored. Clasp hands, rotate torso side to side. V-sit position.

name: Russian Twist — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Same seated V-sit position. Hold one dumbbell with both hands at chest. Rotate side to side. Controlled tempo.

name: Russian Twist — Medicine Ball
setupNotes: Same seated position as bodyweight. Hold medicine ball in both hands. Rotate side to side, touching ball on floor beside hips.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, overhand grip. From dead hang, retract and depress scapulae to raise body slightly without bending elbows. Lat activation.

name: Scapular Push-Up
setupNotes: High plank position, arms straight. Without bending elbows, push shoulder blades apart (protract) then squeeze together (retract). Scapular mobility.

name: Scapular Squeeze — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, arms at sides or slightly raised. Squeeze shoulder blades together and down. Hold 5 seconds, release. Posture and upper back activation.

name: Seated Barbell Overhead Press
setupNotes: Seated, barbell in front rack position at collarbone. Feet hip-width. Press straight overhead, lock out, bar over mid-foot.

name: Seated Box Jump
setupNotes: Sit on a bench or low box facing a plyo box, feet flat and torso upright. From a dead stop, drive through the feet and jump onto the box, landing softly in a quarter squat. Step down and reset. Develops starting-strength power.

name: Seated Cable Row — Neutral Grip — Single-Arm
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, D-handle. Feet on the foot plate, knees slightly bent. Pull the handle to the one side ribs with a neutral (palm-facing) grip, slight rotation of the torso toward the working side. Full stretch at the front, squeeze the shoulder blade at the back. Targets the one side lat and mid-back.

name: Seated Cable Row — Neutral Grip — Single-Arm — Left
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, D-handle. Feet on the foot plate, knees slightly bent. Pull the handle to the left ribs with a neutral (palm-facing) grip, slight rotation of the torso toward the working side. Full stretch at the front, squeeze the shoulder blade at the back. Targets the left lat and mid-back.
parentName: Seated Cable Row — Neutral Grip — Single-Arm

name: Seated Cable Row — Neutral Grip — Single-Arm — Right
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, D-handle. Feet on the foot plate, knees slightly bent. Pull the handle to the right ribs with a neutral (palm-facing) grip, slight rotation of the torso toward the working side. Full stretch at the front, squeeze the shoulder blade at the back. Targets the right lat and mid-back.
parentName: Seated Cable Row — Neutral Grip — Single-Arm

name: Seated Cable Row — Neutral Grip (V-Handle)
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, V-handle attached. Feet on foot plate, knees slightly bent. Pull handle to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Seated Cable Row — Overhand Grip — Single-Arm
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, D-handle. Feet on the foot plate, knees slightly bent. Pull the handle to the one side ribs with an overhand (pronated) grip, elbow flared slightly. Slight torso rotation toward the working side. Emphasises the one side rear delt and upper back.

name: Seated Cable Row — Overhand Grip — Single-Arm — Left
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, D-handle. Feet on the foot plate, knees slightly bent. Pull the handle to the left ribs with an overhand (pronated) grip, elbow flared slightly. Slight torso rotation toward the working side. Emphasises the left rear delt and upper back.
parentName: Seated Cable Row — Overhand Grip — Single-Arm

name: Seated Cable Row — Overhand Grip — Single-Arm — Right
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, D-handle. Feet on the foot plate, knees slightly bent. Pull the handle to the right ribs with an overhand (pronated) grip, elbow flared slightly. Slight torso rotation toward the working side. Emphasises the right rear delt and upper back.
parentName: Seated Cable Row — Overhand Grip — Single-Arm

name: Seated Cable Row — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, straight bar with underhand grip at shoulder-width. Pull to lower chest, elbows close to body.

name: Seated Cable Row — Underhand Grip — Single-Arm
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, D-handle. Feet on the foot plate, knees slightly bent, free hand braced on the thigh. Pull the handle to the lower ribs one arm at a time with an underhand (supinated) grip, elbow tucked close to the body. Let the biceps assist the pull. Emphasises the lower lat and mid-back.

name: Seated Cable Row — Underhand Grip — Single-Arm — Left
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, D-handle. Feet on the foot plate, knees slightly bent, right hand braced on the thigh. Pull the handle to the left lower ribs with an underhand (supinated) grip, elbow tucked close to the body and the biceps assisting. Emphasises the left lower lat and mid-back.
parentName: Seated Cable Row — Underhand Grip — Single-Arm

name: Seated Cable Row — Underhand Grip — Single-Arm — Right
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, D-handle. Feet on the foot plate, knees slightly bent, left hand braced on the thigh. Pull the handle to the right lower ribs with an underhand (supinated) grip, elbow tucked close to the body and the biceps assisting. Emphasises the right lower lat and mid-back.
parentName: Seated Cable Row — Underhand Grip — Single-Arm

name: Seated Cable Row — Wide Grip
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, wide lat bar or straight bar. Overhand grip. Pull to lower chest, elbows out to sides.

name: Seated Calf Raise — Machine
setupNotes: Seated calf raise machine. Knee pad on lower thighs, balls of feet on platform. Rise onto toes, squeeze at top, controlled lower. Targets soleus.

name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
setupNotes: Seated, hold one heavy dumbbell with both hands behind head, elbows pointing up. Extend arms overhead to lockout.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Seated on bench with back support, feet flat. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing each other (neutral). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Seated on bench with back support, feet flat. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward (overhand). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Seated on bench with back support, feet flat. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing you (underhand). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

name: Seated Forward Fold
setupNotes: Sit on floor, legs extended straight. Hinge forward at hips reaching toward feet. Hold. Stretches hamstrings and lower back.

name: Seated Leg Curl
setupNotes: Seated leg curl machine. Adjust back pad and shin pad. Curl heels toward glutes, controlled return to start. Full range of motion.

name: Seated Smith Machine Calf Raise
setupNotes: Smith machine, bar on upper traps. Balls of feet on edge of platform/plates. Seated variation. Rise and lower with full range.

name: Shoulder Rolls
setupNotes: Standing, roll shoulders forward in circles, then backward. Big controlled circles. Loosens upper traps and shoulder joints.

name: Shoulder Taps with Leg Lift
setupNotes: High plank. Simultaneously lift one hand to opposite shoulder and opposite foot off ground. Double anti-rotation demand.

name: Shrimp Squat
setupNotes: Standing on the one leg, hold the the other foot behind you at the glute with the the other hand. Squat down on the one leg until the the other knee taps the floor, then drive back to standing. Advanced unilateral squat — heavy one side quad and glute load.

name: Shrimp Squat — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the left leg, hold the right foot behind you at the glute with the right hand. Squat down on the left leg until the right knee taps the floor, then drive back to standing. Advanced unilateral squat — heavy left quad and glute load.

name: Shrimp Squat — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the right leg, hold the left foot behind you at the glute with the left hand. Squat down on the right leg until the left knee taps the floor, then drive back to standing. Advanced unilateral squat — heavy right quad and glute load.

name: Side Plank
setupNotes: Lie on the one side, one side forearm on the floor under the shoulder, feet stacked or staggered. Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line from head to heels, the other arm extended toward the ceiling or on the hip. Hold for time. Loads the one side obliques and QL.

name: Side Plank — Left Side
setupNotes: Lie on the left side, left forearm on the floor under the shoulder, feet stacked or staggered. Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line from head to heels, right arm extended toward the ceiling or on the hip. Hold for time. Loads the left obliques and QL.

name: Side Plank — Right Side
setupNotes: Lie on the right side, right forearm on the floor under the shoulder, feet stacked or staggered. Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line from head to heels, left arm extended toward the ceiling or on the hip. Hold for time. Loads the right obliques and QL.

name: Side Plank with Hip Dips
setupNotes: Side plank on the one side forearm, hips lifted in a straight line. Slowly lower the one hip toward the floor without touching, then drive back up to the start. Controlled reps through full range. Dynamic loading of the one side obliques.

name: Side Plank with Hip Dips — Left Side
setupNotes: Side plank on the left forearm, hips lifted in a straight line. Slowly lower the left hip toward the floor without touching, then drive back up to the start. Controlled reps through full range. Dynamic loading of the left obliques.

name: Side Plank with Hip Dips — Right Side
setupNotes: Side plank on the right forearm, hips lifted in a straight line. Slowly lower the right hip toward the floor without touching, then drive back up to the start. Controlled reps through full range. Dynamic loading of the right obliques.

name: Side Plank with Leg Lift
setupNotes: Side plank on the one side forearm with hips lifted. Raise the the other side (top) leg upward and hold or pulse at the top while keeping the hips square. Adds glute medius and outer-hip work to the one side-side oblique hold.

name: Side Plank with Leg Lift — Left Side
setupNotes: Side plank on the left forearm with hips lifted. Raise the right (top) leg upward and hold or pulse at the top while keeping the hips square. Adds glute medius and outer-hip work to the left-side oblique hold.

name: Side Plank with Leg Lift — Right Side
setupNotes: Side plank on the right forearm with hips lifted. Raise the left (top) leg upward and hold or pulse at the top while keeping the hips square. Adds glute medius and outer-hip work to the right-side oblique hold.

name: Side Stretch
setupNotes: Standing tall, raise one arm overhead and reach over to the opposite side, letting the hip push out. Feel the stretch along the side of the torso and lats. Hold both sides.

name: Side Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Standing tall, raise the right arm overhead and reach over to the left side, letting the right hip push out. Feel the stretch along the left side of the torso and lats. Hold.

name: Side Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Standing tall, raise the left arm overhead and reach over to the right side, letting the left hip push out. Feel the stretch along the right side of the torso and lats. Hold.

name: Simultaneous Dumbbell Biceps Curl — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on a bench, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Simultaneous curl. Full supination at top, controlled lower. Elbows stationary.

name: Simultaneous Dumbbell Biceps Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Simultaneous curl. Full supination at top, controlled lower. Elbows stationary.

name: Simultaneous Hammer Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbell in each hand at sides with neutral (palms-in) grip. Curl both arms up at the same time, thumbs pointing up. Lower under control — both arms move together every rep.

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing the machine, handle in the one side hand, free hand braced on the machine for stability. Curl the one side arm to the shoulder with a supinated grip — keep the elbow pinned to the ribs. Constant cable tension throughout.

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl — Left Arm
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing the machine, handle in the left hand, free hand braced on the machine for stability. Curl the left arm to the shoulder with a supinated grip — keep the elbow pinned to the ribs. Constant cable tension throughout.

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl — Right Arm
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing the machine, handle in the right hand, free hand braced on the machine for stability. Curl the right arm to the shoulder with a supinated grip — keep the elbow pinned to the ribs. Constant cable tension throughout.

name: Single-Arm Cable Overhead Extension
setupNotes: Single high cable pulley with rope attachment. Stand facing away from machine, rope held overhead with one hand. Extend arm forward and up, locking out triceps. Switch sides each set. Performed unilaterally — see L/R children for side-specific demos.

name: Single-Arm Cable Overhead Extension — Left
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, rope attachment. Face away from the machine in a split stance, left arm overhead with elbow tucked. Extend the left arm forward from behind the head to full lockout, free hand braced on hip. Loads the left triceps with constant cable tension.

name: Single-Arm Cable Overhead Extension — Right
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, rope attachment. Face away from the machine in a split stance, right arm overhead with elbow tucked. Extend the right arm forward from behind the head to full lockout, free hand braced on hip. Loads the right triceps with constant cable tension.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Extension — Left Arm — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on upright bench with back support, one dumbbell held overhead in the left hand with arm fully extended. Bend at the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind the head, elbow pointing straight up and pinned in place. Extend back to lockout. Back support removes lumbar stress and isolates the triceps.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Extension — Left Arm — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, one dumbbell held overhead in the left hand with arm fully extended. Bend at the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind the head, elbow pointing straight up and pinned in place. Extend back to lockout, squeeze the triceps. Brace the core to prevent lower-back arching.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Extension — Right Arm — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on upright bench with back support, one dumbbell held overhead in the right hand with arm fully extended. Bend at the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind the head, elbow pointing straight up and pinned in place. Extend back to lockout. Back support removes lumbar stress and isolates the triceps.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Extension — Right Arm — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, one dumbbell held overhead in the right hand with arm fully extended. Bend at the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind the head, elbow pointing straight up and pinned in place. Extend back to lockout, squeeze the triceps. Brace the core to prevent lower-back arching.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Extension — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on upright bench with back support, one dumbbell held overhead with arm fully extended. Bend at the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind the head, elbow pointing straight up and pinned in place. Extend back to lockout. Back support removes lumbar stress and isolates the triceps.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Extension — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, one dumbbell held overhead with arm fully extended. Bend at the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind the head, elbow pointing straight up and pinned in place. Extend back to lockout, squeeze the triceps. Brace the core to prevent lower-back arching.

name: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Iso-lateral plate-loaded low row, working one side at a time. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip one handle with a neutral (palm-facing) grip, free hand braced on chest pad. Pull the handle to the ribs with elbow tracking close to body. Allows asymmetry correction and full lat focus per side.

name: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Neutral Grip — Left
setupNotes: Iso-lateral plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip the left handle with an neutral (pronated) grip, free hand braced on chest pad. Pull the handle to the ribs with elbow flared slightly — targets the left rear delt and upper back.
parentName: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Neutral Grip

name: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Neutral Grip — Right
setupNotes: Iso-lateral plate-loaded low row, right side only. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip the right handle (neutral grip default), free hand braced on chest pad. Pull the handle to the right ribs with elbow tracking close to body — full stretch at the front, squeeze the shoulder blade at the back.
parentName: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Neutral Grip

name: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Iso-lateral plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip the one side handle with an overhand (pronated) grip, free hand braced on chest pad. Pull the handle to the ribs with elbow flared slightly — targets the one side rear delt and upper back.

name: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Overhand Grip — Left
setupNotes: Iso-lateral plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip the left handle with an overhand (pronated) grip, free hand braced on chest pad. Pull the handle to the ribs with elbow flared slightly — targets the left rear delt and upper back.
parentName: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Overhand Grip

name: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Overhand Grip — Right
setupNotes: Iso-lateral plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip the right handle with an overhand (pronated) grip, free hand braced on chest pad. Pull the handle to the ribs with elbow flared slightly — targets the right rear delt and upper back.
parentName: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Overhand Grip

name: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Iso-lateral plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip the one side handle with an underhand (supinated) grip, free hand braced on chest pad. Pull the handle to the lower ribs with elbow tucked close to body — biceps assist, emphasises the one side lat.

name: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Underhand Grip — Left
setupNotes: Iso-lateral plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip the left handle with an underhand (supinated) grip, free hand braced on chest pad. Pull the handle to the lower ribs with elbow tucked close to body — biceps assist, emphasises the left lat.
parentName: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Underhand Grip

name: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Underhand Grip — Right
setupNotes: Iso-lateral plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip the right handle with an underhand (supinated) grip, free hand braced on chest pad. Pull the handle to the lower ribs with elbow tucked close to body — biceps assist, emphasises the right lat.
parentName: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Low Row — Underhand Grip

name: Single-Arm Landmine Press
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment or wedged in corner. Stand in staggered stance, grip end of bar with one hand at shoulder. Press up and forward in an arc to full extension — targets chest and shoulder with unilateral core demand.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Press — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment or wedged in corner. Stand in staggered stance, grip end of bar with one hand at shoulder. Press up and forward in an arc to full extension — targets chest and shoulder with unilateral core demand.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Press — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment or wedged in corner. Stand in staggered stance, grip end of bar with one hand at shoulder. Press up and forward in an arc to full extension — targets chest and shoulder with unilateral core demand.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Row
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Straddle bar, grip end with one hand. Row to hip with slight rotation. Stable stance.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Straddle bar, grip end with one hand. Row to hip with slight rotation. Stable stance.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Straddle bar, grip end with one hand. Row to hip with slight rotation. Stable stance.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Shoulder Press
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment, staggered stance. Grip end of bar at shoulder with one hand. Press upward in an arc until arm is extended — lower slowly.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Shoulder Press — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment, staggered stance. Grip end of bar at shoulder with one hand. Press upward in an arc until arm is extended — lower slowly.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Shoulder Press — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment, staggered stance. Grip end of bar at shoulder with one hand. Press upward in an arc until arm is extended — lower slowly.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
setupNotes: Cable lat pulldown, D-handle attachment. One arm at a time, slight lean toward working side. Full stretch at top, squeeze at bottom.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown — Left Arm
setupNotes: Cable lat pulldown, D-handle attachment. One arm at a time, slight lean toward working side. Full stretch at top, squeeze at bottom.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown — Right Arm
setupNotes: Cable lat pulldown, D-handle attachment. One arm at a time, slight lean toward working side. Full stretch at top, squeeze at bottom.

name: Single-Arm Straight-Arm Pulldown
setupNotes: High cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing the machine, handle in the one side hand with a slight forward hinge, free hand on hip or rack. Pull the one side arm down in a wide arc to the hip, keeping the arm straight. Full lat stretch at the top, hard squeeze at the bottom.

name: Single-Arm Straight-Arm Pulldown — Left Arm
setupNotes: High cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing the machine, handle in the left hand with a slight forward hinge, free hand on hip or rack. Pull the left arm down in a wide arc to the hip, keeping the arm straight. Full lat stretch at the top, hard squeeze at the bottom.

name: Single-Arm Straight-Arm Pulldown — Right Arm
setupNotes: High cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing the machine, handle in the right hand with a slight forward hinge, free hand on hip or rack. Pull the right arm down in a wide arc to the hip, keeping the arm straight. Full lat stretch at the top, hard squeeze at the bottom.

name: Single-Leg Balance Hold
setupNotes: Stand on the one foot, the other foot lifted just off the floor. Hold for 30–60 seconds, eyes forward. Close the eyes for additional challenge. Trains one side ankle stability and proprioception.

name: Single-Leg Balance Hold — Left Leg
setupNotes: Stand on the left foot, right foot lifted just off the floor. Hold for 30–60 seconds, eyes forward. Close the eyes for additional challenge. Trains left ankle stability and proprioception.

name: Single-Leg Balance Hold — Right Leg
setupNotes: Stand on the right foot, left foot lifted just off the floor. Hold for 30–60 seconds, eyes forward. Close the eyes for additional challenge. Trains right ankle stability and proprioception.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
