setupNotes: Standing on the one foot at the edge of a step, ball of the foot on the edge and heel hanging off. Hand on a wall for balance. Rise onto the toes as high as possible, then lower the heel below the step for a full stretch. Trains the one side calf through full range.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the left foot at the edge of a step, ball of the foot on the edge and heel hanging off. Hand on a wall for balance. Rise onto the toes as high as possible, then lower the heel below the step for a full stretch. Trains the left calf through full range.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the right foot at the edge of a step, ball of the foot on the edge and heel hanging off. Hand on a wall for balance. Rise onto the toes as high as possible, then lower the heel below the step for a full stretch. Trains the right calf through full range.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
setupNotes: Upper back on a bench, one side foot planted hip-width, right knee raised or leg extended. Drive the hips up to lockout through the one side heel, squeeze the one side glute hard at the top, lower under control. Heavier than bilateral on a per-leg basis.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust — Left Leg
setupNotes: Upper back on a bench, left foot planted hip-width, right knee raised or leg extended. Drive the hips up to lockout through the left heel, squeeze the left glute hard at the top, lower under control. Heavier than bilateral on a per-leg basis.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust — Right Leg
setupNotes: Upper back on a bench, right foot planted hip-width, left knee raised or leg extended. Drive the hips up to lockout through the right heel, squeeze the right glute hard at the top, lower under control. Heavier than bilateral on a per-leg basis.

name: Single-Leg Press
setupNotes: Leg press machine, back against pad, one side foot centred on platform, right foot off. Press the weight up with the one side leg, lower under control to ~90 degrees. Lighter load than bilateral. Exposes left-side strength imbalances.

name: Single-Leg Press — Left Leg
setupNotes: Leg press machine, back against pad, left foot centred on platform, right foot off. Press the weight up with the left leg, lower under control to ~90 degrees. Lighter load than bilateral. Exposes left-side strength imbalances.

name: Single-Leg Press — Right Leg
setupNotes: Leg press machine, back against pad, right foot centred on platform, left foot off. Press the weight up with the right leg, lower under control to ~90 degrees. Lighter load than bilateral. Exposes right-side strength imbalances.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Barbell
setupNotes: Standing on the one side, barbell held in front of the thighs with both hands. Hinge at the one side hip and extend the right leg behind for counterbalance — back flat, bar tracking close to the shin. Drive through the one side heel to return upright. Loads the one side hamstring and glute under barbell load.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Barbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the left leg, barbell held in front of the thighs with both hands. Hinge at the left hip and extend the right leg behind for counterbalance — back flat, bar tracking close to the shin. Drive through the left heel to return upright. Loads the left hamstring and glute under barbell load.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Barbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the right leg, barbell held in front of the thighs with both hands. Hinge at the right hip and extend the left leg behind for counterbalance — back flat, bar tracking close to the shin. Drive through the right heel to return upright. Loads the right hamstring and glute under barbell load.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Standing on the one side, hands free or holding a light load (bodyweight default). Hinge at the one side hip and extend the right leg behind for counterbalance — back flat, arms reaching toward the floor. Drive through the one side heel to return upright. Trains hip-hinge balance and loads the one side hamstring and glute.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Bodyweight — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the left leg, hands free or holding a light load (bodyweight default). Hinge at the left hip and extend the right leg behind for counterbalance — back flat, arms reaching toward the floor. Drive through the left heel to return upright. Trains hip-hinge balance and loads the left hamstring and glute.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Bodyweight — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the right leg, hands free or holding a light load (bodyweight default). Hinge at the right hip and extend the left leg behind for counterbalance — back flat, arms reaching toward the floor. Drive through the right heel to return upright. Trains hip-hinge balance and loads the right hamstring and glute.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing on the one side, dumbbell in the right hand. Hinge at the one side hip and extend the right leg behind for counterbalance — back flat, dumbbell tracking close to the shin. Drive through the one side heel to return upright. Loads the one side hamstring and glute.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Dumbbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the left leg, dumbbell in the right hand. Hinge at the left hip and extend the right leg behind for counterbalance — back flat, dumbbell tracking close to the shin. Drive through the left heel to return upright. Loads the left hamstring and glute.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Dumbbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the right leg, dumbbell in the left hand. Hinge at the right hip and extend the left leg behind for counterbalance — back flat, dumbbell tracking close to the shin. Drive through the right heel to return upright. Loads the right hamstring and glute.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Kettlebell
setupNotes: Standing on the one side leg, kettlebell in the right hand. Hinge at the one side hip and extend the right leg behind for counterbalance, bell tracking close to the shin. Drive through the one side heel to return upright. Loads the one side hamstring and glute.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Kettlebell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the left leg, kettlebell in the right hand. Hinge at the left hip and extend the right leg behind for counterbalance, bell tracking close to the shin. Drive through the left heel to return upright. Loads the left hamstring and glute.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Kettlebell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the right leg, kettlebell in the left hand. Hinge at the right hip and extend the left leg behind for counterbalance, bell tracking close to the shin. Drive through the right heel to return upright. Loads the right hamstring and glute.

name: Single-Leg Sit-to-Stand
setupNotes: Sit on a chair, one foot planted, the other leg extended off the floor. Stand up using only the one leg — drive through the heel without rocking. Lower under control back to sitting. Builds one side-leg strength with no equipment.

name: Single-Leg Sit-to-Stand — Left Leg
setupNotes: Sit on a chair, left foot planted, right leg extended off the floor. Stand up using only the left leg — drive through the heel without rocking. Lower under control back to sitting. Builds left-leg strength with no equipment.

name: Single-Leg Sit-to-Stand — Right Leg
setupNotes: Sit on a chair, right foot planted, left leg extended off the floor. Stand up using only the right leg — drive through the heel without rocking. Lower under control back to sitting. Builds right-leg strength with no equipment.

name: Sissy Squat
setupNotes: Standing, hold something for balance. Lean back, push knees forward over toes, lower body. Extreme quad stretch. Can use sissy squat bench.

name: Sit-to-Stand
setupNotes: Sit on sturdy chair or bench. Stand up without using hands. Sit back down controlled. Functional leg strength for all levels.

name: Ski Erg
setupNotes: Ski erg machine. Stand, grip handles overhead. Pull down using lats and core, hinge slightly at hips. Return arms overhead. Steady or interval pace.

name: Skipping Rope
setupNotes: Jump rope on firm flat surface. Light bounce on balls of feet, wrists control rope rotation. Various speeds and footwork patterns.

name: Sled Pull — Backward Walk
setupNotes: Attach strap to sled, harness around waist. Walk backward pulling sled. Upright torso. Quad and glute emphasis.

name: Sled Pull — Hand-Over-Hand
setupNotes: Attach long rope to sled. Sit or stand at end of rope. Pull sled toward you hand over hand. Upper back and bicep emphasis.

name: Sled Push — Heavy (Strength)
setupNotes: Load sled heavy. Low handle grip, lean forward at ~45 degrees. Short powerful steps, drive through toes. Strength and leg power focus.

name: Sled Push — Reverse (Backward)
setupNotes: Face sled, grip handles, walk or drive backward pulling sled toward you with each step. Quad-dominant movement. Knee-friendly.

name: Sled Push — Sprint
setupNotes: Light-moderate load on sled. High handles or low. Sprint for short distance (20-40 metres). Maximum speed effort.

name: Sled Push — Standard
setupNotes: Load sled with moderate weight. Grip high or low handles. Drive forward with legs, steady pace for distance. Lean into sled.

name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Smith machine, bar at knee height. Hinge at hips, grip bar overhand. Row to lower chest. Guided bar path.

name: Smith Machine Front Squat
setupNotes: Smith machine bar racked across front delts in front-rack or cross-arm position. Feet shoulder-width and slightly forward of the bar path. Squat down keeping torso upright, drive up through heels. Fixed bar path lets you focus purely on squat depth and quad engagement.

name: Smith Machine Shrug
setupNotes: Stand centred in Smith machine, bar at hip level. Overhand grip, shoulder-width. Shrug straight up — machine guides the path.

name: Smith Machine Squat
setupNotes: Smith machine, bar on upper back. Feet slightly forward of bar. Descend to parallel, press up. Machine guides bar path vertically.

name: Spider Curl — Barbell
setupNotes: Prone on incline bench (chest at top). Arms hang straight down, barbell in hands. Curl up with zero momentum. Constant tension.

name: Spider Curl — Barbell EZ Bar
setupNotes: Prone on incline bench (chest at top). Arms hang straight down, EZ-curl bar in hands with semi-pronated grip. Curl bar up toward chin without swinging shoulders. Eliminates body english — pure peak-bicep contraction with friendlier wrist angle than a straight bar.

name: Spider Mountain Climbers
setupNotes: High plank. Bring knee to outside of same-side elbow (wider than standard climber). Alternate. Hip mobility plus core work.

name: Spiderman Plank
setupNotes: High plank position. Bring one knee to same-side elbow, return, alternate. Engages obliques and hip flexors with each rep.

name: Spiderman Push-Up
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. As you lower into the push-up, draw the one knee out to meet the one side elbow. Return the leg as you press back up. Adds oblique and hip-flexor work to the chest press.

name: Spiderman Push-Up — Left
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. As you lower into the push-up, draw the left knee out to meet the left elbow. Return the leg as you press back up. Adds oblique and hip-flexor work to the chest press.

name: Spiderman Push-Up — Right
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. As you lower into the push-up, draw the right knee out to meet the right elbow. Return the leg as you press back up. Adds oblique and hip-flexor work to the chest press.

name: Spin Bike — Standing Climb
setupNotes: Spin bike with heavy resistance. Stand on pedals and pedal while standing, simulating uphill climb. Grip handlebars firmly.

name: Squat Jacks
setupNotes: Like jumping jacks but lower — jump feet wide into squat, then jump feet together to standing. Arms punch out or overhead at top.

name: Squat-to-Stand
setupNotes: Standing, fold forward touching toes (bend knees if needed). Grab toes, squat hips down, lift chest to deep squat. Stand up. Repeat. Mobility and legs.

name: Stability Ball Jackknife
setupNotes: High plank position with shins on stability ball. Pull knees toward chest rolling ball forward (jackknife). Extend back to plank.

name: Stability Ball Leg Extension Dead Bug
setupNotes: Lie face up, calves on stability ball. Dead bug arm movements while legs maintain contact with ball. Core stability focus.

name: Stability Ball Pike
setupNotes: High plank with feet/shins on stability ball. Pike hips upward, pulling ball toward hands. Legs stay straight. Advanced.

name: Stability Ball Plank
setupNotes: Forearms on stability ball, feet on floor. Hold plank position. Ball creates instability, demanding more core stabilisation.

name: Stability Ball Plank — Alternating Leg Lift
setupNotes: Forearms on a stability ball, feet on the floor in plank position. Lift one foot a few inches off the ground, hold briefly, then alternate. Keep hips square and core braced — the unstable elbow base plus single-leg support stacks anti-rotation demand on the trunk.

name: Stability Ball Roll-In (Knee Tuck)
setupNotes: High plank position with shins on stability ball. Pull knees toward chest, rolling ball forward. Extend back. Controlled tempo.

name: Stability Ball Rollout
setupNotes: Kneel behind stability ball, forearms on ball. Roll ball forward extending body, then pull back to start. Similar to ab wheel.

name: Staggered/Offset Push-Up
setupNotes: One hand placed forward, the other back by ~6 inches. Body straight. Push up, switch hand positions between sets.

name: StairMaster — Intervals
setupNotes: StairMaster. Alternate fast and slow stepping, or change levels. Hands off rails for best effect. Short burst high effort, longer recovery.

name: StairMaster — Steady Climb
setupNotes: StairMaster or stepmill. Steady stepping pace, hands light on rails (don't lean on them). Upright posture. Glute and cardio focus.

name: Standard Box Jump
setupNotes: Plyo box at appropriate height. Stand facing box, quarter squat and swing arms, jump onto box landing softly in squat. Step down. Standard start.

name: Standard Hammer Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbells at sides with neutral (palms-in) grip throughout. Curl up keeping thumbs pointing up. Standard.

name: Standard Lat Pulldown — Machine
setupNotes: Plate-loaded or selectorised lat pulldown machine. Adjust thigh pad. Grip handles, pull to upper chest with controlled form.

name: Standard Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar at height allowing full hang. Overhand grip just outside shoulder-width. Pull chin over bar, full extension at bottom.

name: Standing Ab Wheel Rollout
setupNotes: Standing, grip ab wheel. Roll forward extending body toward floor, pull back using core. Prevent lower back sag.

name: Standing Barbell Overhead Press
setupNotes: Standing, barbell in front rack position at collarbone. Feet hip-width. Press straight overhead, lock out, bar over mid-foot.

name: Standing Bicycle Crunch
setupNotes: Standing, hands behind head. Drive one knee up while rotating opposite elbow to meet it. Alternate sides. Low-impact core work.

name: Standing Cable Crunch
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope behind head. Standing, feet hip-width. Crunch forward against cable resistance. Core stays engaged throughout.

name: Standing Cable Face Pull
setupNotes: Cable at upper-chest height, rope attachment. Pull toward face, hands ending beside ears. Elbows high, squeeze rear delts. Standing.

name: Standing Calf Raise — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Standing on edge of step or flat floor. Rise up onto toes, squeezing calves at top. Controlled lower. Use wall for balance if needed.

name: Standing Calf Raise — Machine
setupNotes: Standing calf raise machine. Shoulders under pads, balls of feet on edge of platform. Rise onto toes, full extension, controlled lower for stretch at bottom.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Standing, feet shoulder-width apart, core braced. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing each other (neutral). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Standing, feet shoulder-width apart, core braced. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward (overhand). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Standing, feet shoulder-width apart, core braced. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing you (underhand). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

name: Standing Leg Curl — Cable
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, ankle cuff attachment. Stand facing machine, strap on one ankle. Curl heel toward glute, controlled return. Hold something for balance.

name: Standing Leg Curl — Cable — Left
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, ankle-cuff attachment around the left ankle. Stand facing the machine, hold the frame for balance. Curl the left heel toward the glute, squeezing the hamstring at the top, then return under control. Loads the left hamstring with constant cable tension.

name: Standing Leg Curl — Cable — Right
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, ankle-cuff attachment around the right ankle. Stand facing the machine, hold the frame for balance. Curl the right heel toward the glute, squeezing the hamstring at the top, then return under control. Loads the right hamstring with constant cable tension.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
setupNotes: Standing tall, free hand on a wall for balance. Pull the one side foot up toward the one side glute with the one side hand, knees together and hips pressed forward slightly. Hold and breathe. Stretches the one side quad and hip flexor.

name: Standing Quad Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Standing tall, free hand on a wall for balance. Pull the left foot up toward the left glute with the left hand, knees together and hips pressed forward slightly. Hold and breathe. Stretches the left quad and hip flexor.

name: Standing Quad Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Standing tall, free hand on a wall for balance. Pull the right foot up toward the right glute with the right hand, knees together and hips pressed forward slightly. Hold and breathe. Stretches the right quad and hip flexor.

name: Standing Smith Machine Calf Raise
setupNotes: Smith machine, bar on upper traps. Balls of feet on edge of platform/plates. Standing variation. Rise and lower with full range.

name: Star Jumps
setupNotes: Standing, quarter squat then explode upward spreading arms and legs into X/star shape in air. Land softly in squat. Plyometric full body.

name: Static Lunge Hold
setupNotes: Split stance with the one foot forward and the other foot back, both knees bent to ~90 degrees. Hold the position with the back knee hovering above the floor and torso upright. Isometric quad and glute endurance through the one side front leg.

name: Static Lunge Hold — Left Leg
setupNotes: Split stance with the left foot forward and right foot back, both knees bent to ~90 degrees. Hold the position with the back knee hovering above the floor and torso upright. Isometric quad and glute endurance through the left front leg.

name: Static Lunge Hold — Right Leg
setupNotes: Split stance with the right foot forward and left foot back, both knees bent to ~90 degrees. Hold the position with the back knee hovering above the floor and torso upright. Isometric quad and glute endurance through the right front leg.

name: Stationary Bike — Steady
setupNotes: Adjust seat height so slight bend at bottom of pedal stroke. Steady moderate resistance. Upright or recumbent position. Sustained pace.

name: Step-Up — Barbell
setupNotes: Bench or box at knee height, barbell on upper back. Place one side foot fully on box, drive through one side heel to stand tall on top. Controlled step down. All reps on one side leg.

name: Step-Up — Barbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Bench or box at knee height, barbell on upper back. Place left foot fully on box, drive through left heel to stand tall on top. Controlled step down. All reps on left leg.

name: Step-Up — Barbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Bench or box at knee height, barbell on upper back. Place right foot fully on box, drive through right heel to stand tall on top. Controlled step down. All reps on right leg.

name: Step-Up — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Sturdy bench or plyo box at knee height. Dumbbells at sides. Plant the one side foot fully on the box and drive through the one side heel to stand tall — right foot follows or stays grounded for balance. Step down with control through the one side leg. Loads the one side quad and glute.

name: Step-Up — Dumbbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Sturdy bench or plyo box at knee height. Dumbbells at sides. Plant the left foot fully on the box and drive through the left heel to stand tall — right foot follows or stays grounded for balance. Step down with control through the left leg. Loads the left quad and glute.

name: Step-Up — Dumbbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Sturdy bench or plyo box at knee height. Dumbbells at sides. Plant the right foot fully on the box and drive through the right heel to stand tall — left foot follows or stays grounded for balance. Step down with control through the right leg. Loads the right quad and glute.

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
setupNotes: High cable pulley, straight bar or rope attachment. Stand facing machine, arms extended overhead. Pull bar down to thighs in arc, lats engaged.

name: Suitcase Carry
setupNotes: Hold one heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in the one side hand at the side. Walk in a straight line keeping the torso tall and shoulders level — resist the load pulling you into a left-side lean. Anti-lateral-flexion through the right obliques and QL.

name: Suitcase Carry — Left
setupNotes: Hold one heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in the left hand at the side. Walk in a straight line keeping the torso tall and shoulders level — resist the load pulling you into a left-side lean. Anti-lateral-flexion through the right obliques and QL.

name: Suitcase Carry — Right
setupNotes: Hold one heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in the right hand at the side. Walk in a straight line keeping the torso tall and shoulders level — resist the load pulling you into a right-side lean. Anti-lateral-flexion through the left obliques and QL.

name: Sumo Barbell Deadlift
setupNotes: Barbell on floor, wide stance with toes pointed out (sumo). Grip bar between knees, arms straight. Flat back, chest up — drive through heels to lockout.

name: Sumo Squat — Barbell
setupNotes: Bar on back, wide stance with toes pointed out ~45 degrees. Descend between legs, knees track over toes. Adductor and glute emphasis.

name: Sumo Squat (Wide-Stance)
setupNotes: Wide stance, toes pointed out 45 degrees. Squat straight down between legs, knees track over toes. Adductor and glute focus.

name: Superman Hold
setupNotes: Lie face down on mat, arms extended overhead. Simultaneously lift arms, chest, and legs off floor. Hold, squeezing glutes and back.

name: Superman Pull (W-Pull)
setupNotes: Lie face down, arms overhead. Lift chest and pull elbows back into W position, squeezing shoulder blades together. Extend arms, repeat.

name: Superman with Physio Ball — Alternating
setupNotes: Lie face down on a mat, physio ball under the hips for support, arms extended overhead. Lift the opposite arm and leg simultaneously (right arm + left leg), hold briefly, then alternate. Ball provides counter-pressure under the hips — squeeze glutes and lower back on each rep.

name: Superman with Physio Ball + Shoulder ROM
setupNotes: Lie prone, hold physio ball in both hands. Lift chest and ball, then move ball through full shoulder range of motion overhead.

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch with Band
setupNotes: Lie face up with a strap or band looped around the one foot. Extend the one leg toward the ceiling, keeping the knee soft, and gently pull the band for a deeper stretch. the other leg stays flat on the floor. Targets the one side hamstring.

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch with Band — Left
setupNotes: Lie face up with a strap or band looped around the left foot. Extend the left leg toward the ceiling, keeping the knee soft, and gently pull the band for a deeper stretch. Right leg stays flat on the floor. Targets the left hamstring.

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch with Band — Right
setupNotes: Lie face up with a strap or band looped around the right foot. Extend the right leg toward the ceiling, keeping the knee soft, and gently pull the band for a deeper stretch. Left leg stays flat on the floor. Targets the right hamstring.

name: Supine Heel Slide
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees bent, feet flat and pelvis in neutral. Slowly slide the one side heel along the floor until the leg is straight, then draw it back under control. Maintain a stable pelvis throughout — trains deep core and lumbopelvic control.

name: Supine Heel Slide — Left
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees bent, feet flat and pelvis in neutral. Slowly slide the left heel along the floor until the leg is straight, then draw it back under control. Maintain a stable pelvis throughout — trains deep core and lumbopelvic control.

name: Supine Heel Slide — Right
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees bent, feet flat and pelvis in neutral. Slowly slide the right heel along the floor until the leg is straight, then draw it back under control. Maintain a stable pelvis throughout — trains deep core and lumbopelvic control.

name: Supine Spinal Twist
setupNotes: Lie face up, arms out in a T. Pull the one knee up and across the body to the the other side, keeping both shoulders pressed to the floor. Let gravity carry the one knee down. Hold and breathe. Gentle rotation of the lumbar spine.

name: Supine Spinal Twist — Left
setupNotes: Lie face up, arms out in a T. Pull the left knee up and across the body to the right side, keeping both shoulders pressed to the floor. Let gravity carry the left knee down. Hold and breathe. Gentle rotation of the lumbar spine.

name: Supine Spinal Twist — Right
setupNotes: Lie face up, arms out in a T. Pull the right knee up and across the body to the left side, keeping both shoulders pressed to the floor. Let gravity carry the right knee down. Hold and breathe. Gentle rotation of the lumbar spine.

name: Svend Press
setupNotes: Standing, hold two small plates squeezed together at chest height. Press outward while maintaining squeeze. Constant chest contraction.

name: Swiss Ball Hamstring Curl
setupNotes: Lie face up, heels on top of swiss ball, hips lifted. Curl ball toward glutes by bending knees, extend back. Hips stay elevated.

name: Swiss Ball Hip Flexor Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Kneeling lunge with the left shin resting on a swiss ball behind, right foot forward. Tuck the pelvis under and push the hips forward until a stretch is felt at the front of the left hip. Ball cushions the shin and adds slight instability.

name: Swiss Ball Hip Flexor Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Kneeling lunge with the right shin resting on a swiss ball behind, left foot forward. Tuck the pelvis under and push the hips forward until a stretch is felt at the front of the right hip. Ball cushions the shin and adds slight instability.

name: Swiss Ball Side Plank with Leg Lift
setupNotes: one side forearm on floor, feet stacked on swiss ball (one side down). Lift top (the other side) leg while holding a tall side plank. Ball adds instability — brace core hard. Hold for time.

name: Swiss Ball Side Plank with Leg Lift — Left
setupNotes: Left forearm on floor, feet stacked on swiss ball (left side down). Lift top (right) leg while holding a tall side plank. Ball adds instability — brace core hard. Hold for time.
parentName: Swiss Ball Side Plank with Leg Lift

name: Swiss Ball Side Plank with Leg Lift — Right
setupNotes: Right forearm on floor, feet stacked on swiss ball (right side down). Lift top (left) leg while holding a tall side plank. Ball adds instability — brace core hard. Hold for time.
parentName: Swiss Ball Side Plank with Leg Lift

name: Swiss Ball V-Pass
setupNotes: Lie face up, swiss ball in hands overhead. Crunch up passing ball from hands to feet, lower. Next rep pass back to hands.

name: T-Hold (Lateral Arm Hold)
setupNotes: Standing, arms extended straight to sides at shoulder height. Hold for prescribed time. Shoulder endurance, medial deltoid isometric.

name: Tate Press
setupNotes: Flat bench, dumbbells extended above chest with palms facing feet. Lower dumbbells inward so ends touch on chest, press back up.

name: Tate Press — Single-Arm
setupNotes: Lie on flat bench, single dumbbell extended above chest in each hand, palm facing feet. Bend the elbow inward so the dumbbell tracks toward the right side of the chest — end of dumbbell lightly touches chest. Press back up to lockout. Hits the long head of the triceps with a unique angle.

name: Tate Press — Single-Arm — Left
setupNotes: Lie on flat bench, single dumbbell extended above chest in left hand, palm facing feet. Bend the elbow inward so the dumbbell tracks toward the right side of the chest — end of dumbbell lightly touches chest. Press back up to lockout. Hits the long head of the triceps with a unique angle.

name: Tate Press — Single-Arm — Right
setupNotes: Lie on flat bench, single dumbbell extended above chest in right hand, palm facing feet. Bend the elbow inward so the dumbbell tracks toward the left side of the chest — end of dumbbell lightly touches chest. Press back up to lockout. Hits the long head of the triceps with a unique angle.

name: Thread the Needle
setupNotes: On hands and knees, reach the one arm under the body through the space between the the other hand and the other knee, lowering the one side shoulder and ear to the floor. Hold and breathe. Rotates the one side thoracic spine.

name: Thread the Needle — Left
setupNotes: On hands and knees, reach the left arm under the body through the space between the right hand and right knee, lowering the left shoulder and ear to the floor. Hold and breathe. Rotates the left thoracic spine.

name: Thread the Needle — Right
setupNotes: On hands and knees, reach the right arm under the body through the space between the left hand and left knee, lowering the right shoulder and ear to the floor. Hold and breathe. Rotates the right thoracic spine.

name: Toes-to-Bar
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar, legs straight. Raise toes all the way to touch the bar. Requires hamstring flexibility and strong core. Controlled lower.

name: Trap Bar Row
setupNotes: Trap bar loaded, hinge at hips. Grip both handles with neutral grip. Row to torso, squeeze upper back. Neutral grip reduces bicep strain.

name: Trap Bar Shrug
setupNotes: Standing inside trap bar loaded with weight. Grip handles, arms straight. Shrug shoulders up toward ears. Neutral grip reduces wrist strain.

name: Treadmill Jog
setupNotes: Treadmill set to jogging pace (7-9 km/h). Easy conversational pace. Land mid-foot, relaxed shoulders and arms.

name: Treadmill Run
setupNotes: Treadmill set to running pace (10-14 km/h). Moderate to hard effort. Good running form — upright posture, mid-foot strike, relaxed hands.

name: Treadmill Sprint
setupNotes: Treadmill set to sprint speed (15+ km/h) or maximum effort for short intervals (15-30 seconds). Hold side rails to mount/dismount safely.

name: Treadmill Walk
setupNotes: Treadmill set to comfortable walking speed (4-6 km/h). Upright posture, arms swinging naturally. Incline optional for added effort.

name: Triceps Pushdown — Reverse Grip
setupNotes: High cable pulley, straight bar with underhand (supinated) grip. Push down to full extension. Emphasises medial head of triceps.

name: Triceps Pushdown — Rope
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope attachment. Stand facing machine. Push down and split rope apart at bottom for extra contraction. Elbows stationary.

name: Triceps Pushdown — Straight Bar
setupNotes: High cable pulley, straight bar attachment. Stand facing machine, elbows pinned to sides. Push bar down to full extension, controlled return.

name: Triceps Pushdown — V-Bar
setupNotes: High cable pulley, V-bar attachment. Neutral grip. Push down to full extension. Comfortable on wrists, good triceps isolation.

name: Turkish Get-Up
setupNotes: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in one hand pressed straight up, eyes on the bell. Move through the get-up sequence — roll to the elbow, to the hand, hip up, sweep the trail leg through, lunge, stand — keeping the loaded arm vertically locked the entire time. Reverse step-by-step to the floor.

name: Turkish Get-Up — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in the left hand pressed straight up, eyes on the bell. Move through the get-up sequence — roll to the right elbow, to the right hand, hip up, sweep the right leg through, lunge, stand — keeping the left arm vertically locked. Reverse to the floor. Full-body unilateral control.

name: Turkish Get-Up — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in the right hand pressed straight up, eyes on the bell. Move through the get-up sequence — roll to the left elbow, to the left hand, hip up, sweep the left leg through, lunge, stand — keeping the right arm vertically locked. Reverse to the floor. Full-body unilateral control.

name: Twisting/Supinating Curl
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbells at sides with neutral grip. As you curl up, rotate wrist from neutral to supinated (palms up). Squeeze at top.

name: Twisting/Supinating Curl — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on a bench, dumbbell in each hand with neutral grip. As you curl, rotate the wrists so the palms face up at the top — supinated finish. Controlled lower back to neutral. Targets the biceps with emphasis on the short head.

name: Upper Trap Stretch
setupNotes: Seated tall, place the one hand behind the back. Tilt the head away from the one side shoulder and use the the other hand on the head for gentle additional pressure. Hold. Releases tension in the one side upper trap.

name: Upper Trap Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Seated tall, place the left hand behind the back. Tilt the head away from the left shoulder and use the right hand on the head for gentle additional pressure. Hold. Releases tension in the left upper trap.

name: Upper Trap Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Seated tall, place the right hand behind the back. Tilt the head away from the right shoulder and use the left hand on the head for gentle additional pressure. Hold. Releases tension in the right upper trap.

name: V-Up
setupNotes: Lie face up, arms overhead, legs straight. Simultaneously lift arms and legs to touch hands to feet at top. V shape at peak. Controlled lower.

name: Waiter Curl
setupNotes: Standing, hold one dumbbell vertically with both palms under the top plate. Curl up keeping elbows close. Long head emphasis at peak contraction.

name: Walking Lunge — Barbell
setupNotes: Open floor space, barbell on upper back. Step forward into a deep lunge — front knee tracking over toes. Push off front foot, bring rear foot forward into next lunge.

name: Walking Lunge — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Open floor space (10+ metres). Step forward into lunge, back knee toward floor, push off front foot into next step. Continuous forward motion.

name: Walking Lunge — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Open floor space, dumbbells at sides. Step forward into a deep lunge — front knee tracking over toes. Push off front foot, bring rear foot forward into next lunge.

name: Walking Lunge — Front Rack
setupNotes: Open floor space, barbell in front rack position. Step forward into a deep lunge — front knee tracking over toes. Push off front foot, bring rear foot forward into next lunge.

name: Walking Lunge with Twist
setupNotes: Step into forward lunge, rotate torso toward front leg. Arms extended or hands together. Return to standing, step other leg. Dynamic stretch.

name: Wall Push-Up
setupNotes: Standing arm's-length from wall, hands on wall at shoulder height. Lean in, press back. Beginner regression, control tempo.

name: Wall Sit — Single-Leg
setupNotes: Back flat against the wall, knees bent to ~90 degrees as in a standard wall sit. Extend the right leg straight forward, all weight on the one side leg. Hold for time. Significantly harder — isometric load on the one side quad.

name: Wall Sit — Single-Leg — Left Leg
setupNotes: Back flat against the wall, knees bent to ~90 degrees as in a standard wall sit. Extend the right leg straight forward, all weight on the left leg. Hold for time. Significantly harder — isometric load on the left quad.

name: Wall Sit — Single-Leg — Right Leg
setupNotes: Back flat against the wall, knees bent to ~90 degrees as in a standard wall sit. Extend the left leg straight forward, all weight on the right leg. Hold for time. Significantly harder — isometric load on the right quad.

name: Wall Sit — Standard
setupNotes: Back flat against wall, slide down until thighs parallel to floor. Knees at 90 degrees, directly over ankles. Hold for prescribed time.

name: Wall Sit — Weighted
setupNotes: Standard wall sit position with dumbbell or weight plate on thighs. Increases quad demand. Maintain flat back against wall.

name: Wall Thoracic Extension
setupNotes: Stand facing wall, arms overhead on wall. Slowly push chest toward wall, arching upper back. Hold stretch. Thoracic extension mobility.

name: Weighted Arm Circles
setupNotes: Standing, light dumbbells (1-3 kg) in each hand, arms extended. Small controlled circles. Forward and backward. Shoulder endurance.

name: Weighted Dead Hang
setupNotes: Pull-up bar with dip belt and plates or weighted vest. Full hang, grip endurance and spinal decompression under load.

name: Weighted Decline Crunch
setupNotes: Decline bench, hold weight plate or dumbbell on chest. Crunch up against added resistance. Controlled eccentric back down.

name: Weighted Hanging Leg Raise
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar with light dumbbell between feet or ankle weights. Straight-leg raise to horizontal. Controlled eccentric.

name: Weighted Hollow Hold
setupNotes: Full hollow body position with light dumbbell in hands and/or between feet. Hold position for prescribed time. Advanced.

name: Weighted Superman Hold
setupNotes: Same prone position as standard. Hold light dumbbells in hands and/or light ankle weights. Lift and hold. Controlled breathing.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, overhand grip significantly wider than shoulders. Pull chest toward bar. More lat emphasis, less bicep.

name: Wide-Grip Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands placed 6-8 inches wider than shoulders on floor. Body in straight line, core braced. Lower chest to floor, press up.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
setupNotes: From standing, step the one foot forward into a deep lunge and place both hands on the floor inside the one foot. Rotate the torso toward the one knee and reach the one arm up toward the ceiling. Hold, then return. Mobilises the one hip, T-spine, and hamstring.

name: World's Greatest Stretch — Left
setupNotes: From standing, step the left foot forward into a deep lunge and place both hands on the floor inside the left foot. Rotate the torso toward the left knee and reach the left arm up toward the ceiling. Hold, then return. Mobilises the left hip, T-spine, and hamstring.

name: World's Greatest Stretch — Right
setupNotes: From standing, step the right foot forward into a deep lunge and place both hands on the floor inside the right foot. Rotate the torso toward the right knee and reach the right arm up toward the ceiling. Hold, then return. Mobilises the right hip, T-spine, and hamstring.

name: Wrist Rolls
setupNotes: Extend arms forward, circle wrists in both directions. Open and close fists between circles. Warms up wrist joints for pressing and gripping.

name: Y-Raise — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Prone on incline bench (face down) or standing bent over. Raise dumbbells in Y-shape overhead. Light weight, controlled.

name: Zercher Squat
setupNotes: Bar held in crook of elbows at chest height. Feet shoulder-width. Squat down between arms, bar stays in elbow crease. Pad bar with towel.

name: Zottman Curl
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbells at sides. Curl up with supinated grip (palms up), rotate to pronated grip (palms down) at top, lower slowly with pronated grip.
